a: Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella missota.
Rabbanan savri: ki sota, ma sota safek hi, vaasauha kevadday — hacha name safek, vaasauha kevadday.
I missota, ema ki sota: ma sota birshut harabbim tahor, hacha name birshut harabbim tahor!
Hachi hasheta? hatam mishshum setira hu, usetira birshut harabbim lekka. hacha mishshum chaser hu, ma li chaser birshut harabbim, ma li chaser birshut hayyachid.
Vechi tema, ha kol sefek tumea birshut harabbim tahor! kevan deikka tarte lereuta — kevadday tumea dame.
Verabbi shimon savar: ki sota, ma sota birshut harabbim — tahor, hacha name birshut harabbim — tahor.
I missota, ema ki sota: ma sota birshut hayyachid — temea vadday, hacha name birshut hayyachid — temea vadday!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam yesh raglayim laddavar, shehare kinne lah venistera. hacha may raglayim laddavar ikka?
Vei baet ema, hayeynu tama derabbi shimon: gamar sof tumea mittechillat tumea.
Ma techillat tumea, safek naga safek lo naga — birshut harabbim tahor, af sof tumea, safek taval safek lo taval — birshut harabbim tahor.
Verabbanan? hachi hasheta?! hatam gavra bechezkat tohora kae, missefeka la machatinan leh letumea. hacha gavra bechezkat tumea kae, missefeka la mappekinan leh mittumeato.
Umay shena mimmavoy? ditnan: hashsheretz shennimtza bammavoy — metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar: "badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya bo sheretz", o ad sheat hakkibbud!
Hatam name, kevan deikka sheratzim degufeh, usheratzim deatu mealma — ketarte lereuta dame.
Vei baet ema, hayeynu tama deshammay: hoil veishsha margeshet beatzmah, vehillel — kisvura haregashat me raglayim hi.
Uleshammay, haikka yeshena? yeshena name, aggav tzaara mittara, midde dehave ahargashat me raglayim.
Vehaikka shota! mode shammay beshota. ha "kol hannashim" katane! "kol hannashim" — pikkechot.
Velitne "nashim"! leappoke midderabbi eliezer, deamar rabbi eliezer: "arba nashim" vetu la, ka mashma lan: kol hannashim.
Vehaikka ketamim! lema tenan ketamim dela keshammay? amar abbaye: mode shammay bichtamim. may tama? betzippor lo nitasseka, beshuk shel tabbachim lo avra, hay dam mehecha ate?
I baet ema, hayeynu tameh deshammay: deim ita dahava dam meikkara — hava ate. vehillel — kotle bet harechem heemiduhu, veshammay — kotle bet harechem la mokmi dam.
Meshammeshet bemoch, may ikka lememar? amar abbaye: mode shammay bimshammeshet bemoch.
Rava amar: moch name, aggav zea michvaytz kavetz, umode rava bemoch dachuk.
Umay ikka ben hane lishshane lehaych lishshana?
b: Ikka benayyhu lemirme chavit umikve umavoy — lehaych lishshana ikka lemirminhu, lehane lishshane lekka lemirme.
Umay ikka ben hay lishshana lehaych lishshana? leabbaye ikka moch,
Lerava ikka moch dachuk.

Tanya ki hay lishshana, deim ita dahava dam meikkara hava ate. amar lo hillel leshammay: i atta mode bekuppa shennishtammeshu bah teharot bezavit zo, venimtza sheretz bezavit acheret, shetteharot harishonot temeot? amar lo: aval!
Uma hefresh ben zo lazo? lazo yesh lah shulayim, lezo en lah shulayim.
Rava amar: tama deshammay mishshum bittul periyya ureviyya. tanya name hachi: amar lo shammay lehillel: im ken, bittalta benot yisrael mipperiyya ureviyya.

Uman detane hay lishshana, ha tanya ki haych lishshana, deim ita dahava dam meikkara hava ate. hatam, hillel hu dekatae, hu savar tama deshammay deim ita dahava dam meikkara hava ate, veka makshe leh kuppa.
Veamar leh shammay: tama didi mishshum bittul periyya ureviyya, ulemay dekataet name dekamakshet kuppa — lazo yesh lah shulayim, ulazo en lah shulayim.
Uleman detane hay lishshana, ha tanya ki haych lishshana, mishshum bittul periyya ureviyya!
Hachi kaamar leh hillel leshammay: in, tama kaamrat, deim ita dahava dam meikkara hava ate, umihu ase seyayg lidvarecha, demay shena mikkol hattora kullah deavdinan seyayg?
Amar leh: im ken, bittalta benot yisrael mipperiyya ureviyya! vehillel — mipperiyya ureviyya mi kaamena? litharot hu dekaamena!
Veshammay — litharot name la, deim ken libbo nokfo uforesh.

(Shulayim, bedukin, mechussin bezavit — siman). ittemar: kuppa shennishtammeshu bah teharot bezavit zo, venimtza sheretz bezavit acheret — chizkiyya amar: teharot harishonot tehorot, rabbi yochanan amar: teharot harishonot temeot. veha (bet) shammay vehillel modu bekuppa ditharot harishonot temeot!
Ki modu shammay vehillel bekuppa sheyyesh lah shulayim, ki peligi chizkiyya verabbi yochanan bekuppa sheen lah shulayim.
En lah shulayim, may tama derabbi yochanan? en lah shulayim, veyesh lah ovganim.

Vehatanya: hammadle asara delayim mayim beze achar ze, venimtza sheretz beechad mehen — hu tame, vechullan tehorin. veamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella sheen lah ovganim, aval yesh lah ovganim — kullan temein.
Lema chizkiyya let leh derabbi yannay? mayya sharki, pere la sharki.
I name: mayya la kafed alayyhu, pere kafed alayyhu.
Vei baet ema: ki modu shammay vehillel bekuppa sheenah beduka,

a: Ki peligi chizkiyya verabbi yochanan bekuppa beduka, mar savar: ha badka, umar savar: emor im silluk yado nafal.
Veha dumeya deishsha katane, veishsha beduka hi! kevan dishchichi bah damim — kesheenah beduka damya.
Veibbaet ema: ki modu shammay vehillel bekuppa sheenah mechussa, ki peligi chizkiyya verabbi yochanan bekuppa mechussa. mechussa — hechi nefal? kegon shettashmishah al yede kissuy.
Veha dumeya deishsha katane, veishsha mechussa hi, kevan dishchichi ba damim — kesheen mechussa damya.
Veibbaet ema: ki modu shammay vehillel bezavit kuppa, ki peligi chizkiyya verabbi yochanan bezavit bayit, veha "kuppa" kaamar!

Hachi kaamar: kuppa shennishtammeshu bah teharot bezavit bayit zo, vetilteluha bezavit acheret, venimtza sheretz bezavit acheret. chizkiyya savar: la machzekinan tumea mimmakom lemakom, verabbi yochanan savar: machzekinan.
Umi machzekinan? vehatnan: naga beechad ballayla, veeno yodea im chay im met, ulemachar hishkim umetzao met — rabbi meir metaher.
Vachachamim metammein, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan.
Vetane ala: kishat metziatan, uvimkom metziatan!
Vechi tema: hane mille lisrof, aval litlot — talenan? umi talenan?!
Vehatnan: machat shennimtzet melea chaludda o shevura — tehora, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan. veammay? lema: hay meikkara machat meallayyta hi, vehasheta hu deheela chaludda.
Veod tenan: matza sheretz saruf al gabbe hazzetim, vechen matlit hamehumeham — tahor, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan!
Vechi tema, kishat metziatan ben lekulla ben lechumera, uvimkom metziatan, aval shello bimkom metziatan — misraf la sarfinan, mitle talenan.
Vehatnan: kikkar al gabbe haddaf, umaddaf tame munnach tachtav, af al pi sheim nafla i efshar ella im ken naga — tehora, sheani omer: adam tahor nichnas lesham unetalah,
Ad sheyyomar: "bari li shello nichnas adam sham". veamar rabbi elazar: lo nitzrecha ella limkom midron!
Hatam kidkatane tama,
b: Sheani omer: adam tahor nichnas lesham unetalah.
Hacha name nema: orev ata usheda! adam divchavvana — amrinan, orev deshello bechavvana — la amrinan.

Mikkedi hay kikkar sefek tumea birshut hayyachid hu, vechol sefek tumea birshut hayyachid — sefekah tame, mishshum dehave davar sheen bo daat lishshael, vechol davar sheen bo daat lishshael, ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid — sefeko tahor.
Vei baet ema: hacha betumea derabbanan. dayka name dekatane "maddaf", kedichtiv "ale niddaf".
Vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze kulei. tanu rabbanan: vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze, lo kedivre shammay — shello asa seyayg lidvarav, velo kedivre hillel — shehifriz al middotav.
Ella, meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet.

Meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, ketzad? badka atzmah beechad bashshabbat umatzat tehora, veyashva sheni ushelishi velo badka, velirvii badka umatza temea — en omrim tetamme mippekida lifkida, ella meet leet.

Umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet, ketzad? badka atzmah beshaa rishona umatzat tehora, veyashva lah sheniyya ushelishit velo badka, velirviit badka umatza temea — en omrim tetamme meet leet, ella mippekida lifkida.

Peshita! kevan devadka atzmah beshaa rishona umatzat tehora, la metammenan la meet leet. ayyeyde ditna meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, tena name mippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet.
Amar rabba: may tamayyhu derabbanan? ishsha margeshet beatzmah. amar leh abbaye: im ken, tehe dayya sheatah! verabba lechaddode leabbaye hu devae. ella may tamayyhu derabbanan?

Ki ha deamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: chachamim tikkenu lahen livnot yisrael sheyyehu bodkot atzman shacharit vearvit, shacharit — lehacheshir teharot shel layla, vearvit — lehacheshir teharot shel yom.
Vezo hoil velo badka — hifsida ona. may "ona"? ona yetera.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: veha zimnin mashkachat la shalosh onot bemeet leet! hishvu chachamim middotehen, shello tachlok bemeet leet.
Ibbaet ema, shello yehe chote niskar.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deittenisa, vela bedaka.

Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset [vechulei]. lema matnitin rabbi dosa hi, vela rabbanan? detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: arba nashim dayyayn sheatan — betula, meubberet, menika, uzekena. rabbi dosa omer: kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayya sheatah.
Afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi dosa ella shello bishat vistah, aval bishat vistah modu leh, umatnitin bishat vistah, vedivre hakkol.
Mikkelal derabbi dosa afillu shello bishat vistah amar? man tena leha detanu rabbanan: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset — kitmah tame lemafrea, sheim tire shello bishat vistah — metammea meet leet.

Nema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi dosa? afillu tema rabbi dosa, ad kan la pelig rabbi dosa alayyhu derabbanan ella bishat vistah, aval shello bishat vistah mode lehu, umatnitin bishat vistah verabbi dosa hi,

a: Uvarayyta divre hakkol.
Velokma ippecha!
Kevan deikka leokome lekulla ulechumera — lechumera mokminan.
Katane: sheim tire shello bishat vistah metammea meet leet. tama deishsha sheyyesh lah veset hu, difligi rabbanan ben kitmah liriyyaytah,
Ha shear nashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan — kitman kiriyyaytan.

Manni? rabbi chanina ben antignos hi, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina ben antignos: kol hannashim kitman tame lemafrea, venashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan — kitman kiriyyaytan, chutz mittinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot, sheafillu sedinin shellah meluchelachin bedam — en choshshin lah.

Umi it leh lerabbi chanina ketem kelal? vehatanya: kol hannashim kitman tame, venashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan — kitman tame. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: nashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan — en lahen ketem. may lav en lahen ketem kelal? la, en lahen ketem lemafrea, aval yesh lahen ketem mikkan ulehabba.

Mikkelal detanna kamma savar afillu lemafrea? in, rabbi meir hi, demachmer gabbe chetamim. detanya: kol hannashim — kitman tame lemafrea, venashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan — kitman tame lemafrea, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: nashim sheamru chachamim dayyayn sheatan, kitman kiriyyaytan, vetinoket shehiggia zemannah lirot — yesh lah ketem, veshello higgia zemannah lirot — en lah ketem. veematay higgia zemannah lirot? mishshehiggiu yeme hanneurim.
Vehameshammeshet beedim kulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ed shellifne tashmish eno memaet kifkida.
May tama? amar rav kattina: mittoch shemmehumma levetah. vechi mehumma levetah may have? mittoch shemmehumma levetah — enah machneset lechorin velisdakin.

Tenan: hameshammeshet beedim, hare zo kifkida. may lav chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish? la, idde veidde leachar tashmish, veechad lo veechad lah. keditnan: derech benot yisrael meshammeshot bishne edim, echad lo veechad lah.

Hay may? i amrat bishlama chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish — itzterich, salka datach amena: mittoch shemmehumma levetah la badka shappir, ka mashma lan hare zo kifkida. ella i amrat idde veidde leachar tashmish — peshita!
Mahu detema, shemma tire tippat dam kechardal utechappenna shichvat zera, ka mashma lan.
Veibbaet ema: shete vedikot atzrechuha rabbanan, chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish, vechi katane "hare zo kifkida" — alleachar tashmish, veha "hameshammeshet" katane! teni: "umeshammeshet".
Memaetet al yad meet leet, hasheta meet leet memaetet,
b: Mippekida lifkida mibbaya?!
Mahu detema: meet leet — chashshu ba rabbanan lifseda ditharot, aval mippekida lifkida — la, ka mashma lan.
Ketzad dayya sheatah vechulei. lema li lemitne: "hayta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka bitharot"? litne: "hayta asuka bitharot ufarsha veraata"!
Ha ka mashma lan: tama dedayyah sheatah, ha meet leet — mitta name metammeya. mesayyay leh lizeri, deamar zeeri: meet leet shebbenidda osa mishkav umoshav, letamme adam letamme begadim.
Mikkedi hay mitta davar sheen bo daat lishshael hu, vechol davar sheen bo daat lishshael — sefeko tahor! targema zeeri keshechavroteha nosot otah bammitta, dehavya lay yad chavroteha.
Vehasheta deamar rabbi yochanan: sefek tumea habbaa bide adam — nishalin aleha, afillu bichli munnach al gabbe karka kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishshael, af al pi sheen chavroteha nosot otah bammitta.
Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan: sefek tumea habbaa bide adam — nishalim aleha, afillu bichli hammunnach al gabbe karka kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishshael.
Metivi: haya mitattef betallito, uteharot vetumeot betziddo, uteharot vetumeot lemala merosho, safek naga safek lo naga — tahor, veim i efshar ella im ken naga — tame.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: omrim lo: "shene", veshone. amru lo: en shonim bitharot.
Ammay? ha sefek tumea habbaa bide adam hu!
Bar minneh dehahi, detane rav hoshaya: birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame, birshut harabbim — tahor.
Gufa: amar zeeri: meet leet shebbenidda ose mishkav umoshav, letamme adam letamme begadim.
Ini? veha ki ata avimi mibbe chozae, ata veayyti matnita bideh: meet leet shebbenidda — mishkavah umoshavah kemaggaah. may lav, ma maggaah lo metamme adam, af mishkavah lo metamme adam!

Amar rava: vetisbera? kal vachomer hu: uma keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, hannitztzol beohel hammet, eno nitztzol bemeet leet shebbenidda — mishkavot umoshavot, sheenan nitztzolin beohel hammet, eno din sheen nitztzolin bemeet leet shebbenidda?
Veha avimi mibbe chozae matnita kaamar! ema: mishkavah umoshavah

a: Kemagga atzmah, ma magga atzmah metamme adam letamme begadim, af mishkavah umoshavah metamme adam letamme begadim.

Tanya kevavteh derava: haroa dam — metammea meet leet, uma hi metammea? mishkavot umoshavot, ovchalin umashkin, ucheli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, veenah mekulekelet leminyanah, veenah metammea et boalah lemafrea. rabbi akiva omer: metamme et boalah, veenah mona ella mishshaa sheraata.

Haroa ketem, metammea lemafrea, uma hi metammea? ovchalin umashkin, mishkavot umoshavot, ucheli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, umekulekelet leminyanah, umetammea et boalah, veenah mona ella mishshaa sheraata.
Veze vaze tolin, lo ochlin velo sorfin.
Verava, i shemia leh matnita — lema matnita, vei la shemia leh matnita — kal vachomer mena leh?
Leolam shemia leh matnita, vei mimmatnita hava amena: o adam o begadim, aval adam uvegadim — la, mishshum hachi kaamar kal vachomer.
Amar rav huna: meet leet shebbenidda lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. i hachi, litne gabbe maalot! ki katane hecha deit leh derara detumea, aval hecha delet leh derara detumea — la katane.
Metivi: ma hi metammea? ovchalin umashkin. may lav, ben dekodesh ben ditruma? la, dekodesh.
Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer, af bishat avaratan milleechol bitruma. vehavenan ba: may dahava hava!
Amar rav chisda: lo nitzrecha ella letakken shirayim shebbefaneha.
Rav huna matne lisrof shirayim shebbeyadeha, shebbadka atzmah keshiur veset.
Ta shema: maase, veasa rabbi kerabbi eliezer.
Leachar shennizkar, amar: keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav
b: Bishat haddechak. vehavenan ba: may "leachar shennizkar"? illema leachar shennizkar deen halacha kerabbi eliezer ella kerabbanan, bishat haddechak hechi aved kevateh?
Ella (lav) dela ittemar hilcheta, la kemar vela kemar, vechevan shennizkar delav yachid pelig aleh, ella rabbim peligi aleh, amar: "keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak".
I amrat bishlama litruma, hayeynu dahavay teruma bime rabbi, ella i amrat lekodesh — kodesh bime rabbi mi havay?
Kidulla, deamar ulla: chavrayya medakkan begalila. hacha name bime rabbi.

Ta shema: maase beshifchato shel rabban gamliel shehayta ofa kikkarot shel teruma, uven kol achat veachat medicha yadah bemayim uvodeket, baacharona badka umatza temea, uvat veshaala et rabban gamliel, veamar lah: kullan temeot. amra lo: rabbi, vahalo bedika hayta li ben kol achat veachat! amar lah: im ken, hi temea vechullan tehorot.
Katane mihat: kikkarot shel teruma. may teruma? terumat lachme toda. terumat lachme toda baafiyya may baaya?
Deafreshinhu beleshayyhu, vechi ha deamar rav tovi bar rav kattina: lachme toda sheafaan arba challot — yatza, vehavenan ba: veha baenan arbaim! lemitzva.

Veha baenan afroshe teruma minnayyhu! vechi tema demafresh perusa mikkol chad vechad, "echad" amar rachamana, shello yittol perusa, veamrinan deafreshinhu beleshayyhu, hacha name deafreshinhu beleshayyhu.

Ta shema: shuv maase beshifcha shel rabban gamliel, shehayta gafa chaviyyot shel yayin, uven kol achat veachat medicha yadeha bemayim uvodeket, uvaacharona badka umatza temea, uvat veshaala lerabban gamliel, veamar lah: kullan temeot. amra lo: vahalo bedika hayta li ben kol achat veachat! amar la: im ken, hi temea vechullan tehorot.
I amrat bishlama chada dekodesh, vachada ditruma hi, hayeynu dehadra veshayyla. ella i amrat idde veidde dekodesh, lema la lemehdar uleshayyoleh? maase shehaya — bishte shefachot haya.

Lishshana acharina amri la, amar rav huna: meet leet shebbenidda metammea ben lakkodesh uven latteruma. mimmay? middela katane la gabbe maalot. amar leh rav nachman: veha tane tanna lakkodesh aval lo latteruma!
Kabbela minneh rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: bechullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh, velo bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma.
Tenan hatam: nolad lah sefek tumea, ad shello gilgela — tease betumea, mishsheggilgela — tease betohora.

Ad shello gilgelah — tease betumea, chullin ninhu, umuttar ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael; mishsheggilgela — tease betohora, chullin hattevulin lechalla kechala damu, veasur ligrom tumea lechalla.
Tana:

a: Vechallatah teluya, lo ochlin velo sorfin. beeze safek amru? bisfek challa. may sefek challa?
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: shello tomar behochachot shaninu kemo shene shevilin, dehatam chullin gereda name metammu.
Ella benishan, ditnan: zav vetahor shehayu porkin min hachamor o toanin, bizman shemmassaan kaved — tame, massaan kal — tahor, vechullan tehorin livne hakkeneset, utemein litruma.
Vechullin hattevulin lechalla kechalla damu? vehatanya: ishsha shehi tevulat yom, lasha et haissa, vekotza hemenna challatah, umannichatah bichfisha o beanchuta, umakkefet vekora lah shem.
Mippene shehu shelishi, ushelishi tahor bechullin, vei amrat "chullin hattevulin lechalla kechalla damu", ha tammetinhu!

Amar abbaye: kol shevvadday metamme chullin — gazru al sefeko mishshum chullin hattevulin lechalla, vehay tevul yom, kevan delo metamme vadday chullin — lo gazru alav mishshum chullin hattevulin lechalla.
Veha meet leet shebbenidda, devadday metamme chullin — velo gazru al sefekah mishshum chullin hattevulin lechalla!
Deamar mar: kabbela minneh rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, bechullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh, velo bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma!
Hatam la peticha behu teruma, hacha peticha behu teruma.
Veibbaet ema: hannach meet leet — derabbanan.
Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: arba nashim dayyayn sheatan — betula, meubberet, menika, uzekena. amar rabbi yehoshua: ani lo shamati ella betula.
b: Aval halacha kerabbi eliezer.

Ezo hi betula — kol shello raata dam miyyameha, af al pi shennesua. meubberet — mishsheyyivvada ubbarah. menika — ad shettigmol et benah. natna benah limnika, gemalattu, o met — rabbi meir omer: metammea meet leet, vachachamim omrim: dayyah sheatah.

Ezohi zekena — kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot samuch leziknatah. rabbi eliezer omer: kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot — dayyah sheatah. rabbi yose omer: meubberet umenika sheavru alehen shalosh onot — dayyayn sheatan.
Uvamma amar "dayyah sheatah" — biriyyay rishona, aval bashsheniyya metammea meet leet, veim raata harishona meones — af hashsheniyya dayyah sheatah.
Gemara tanya: amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: atta lo shamata, ani shamati; atta lo shamata ella achat, vaani shamati harebe.

En omrim lemi shello raa et hachodesh "yavo veyaid", ella lemi sheraahu. kol yamav shel rabbi eliezer hayu osin kerabbi yehoshua, leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer hechzir rabbi yehoshua et haddavar leyoshno.
Kerabbi eliezer, bechayyav may tama la? mishshum derabbi eliezer shammuti hu, vesavar: i avdinan kevavteh bachada, avdinan kevavteh beachranyayta.
Umishshum kevodo derabbi eliezer, la matzenan machenan behu. leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer (dematzinu) [dematzenan] machenan behu, hechzir et haddavar leyoshno.
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer bearba. chada: daamaran.
Veiddach: hamekashsha kamma tishpe utehe zava? meet leet, divre rabbi eliezer, vahalacha kidvarav.

Veiddach: hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman yom rishon umatzu tahor, yom shevii umatzu tahor, ushear hayyamim lo badku — rabbi eliezer omer: hare ellu bechezkat tohora. rabbi yehoshua omer: en lahen ella yom harishon veyom hashshevii bilvad.

Rabbi akiva omer: en lahem ella yom shevii bilvad. vetanya: rabbi shimon verabbi yose omrim: nirin divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua, vedivre rabbi akiva middivre chullan, aval halacha kerabbi eliezer.

Veiddach, ditnan: achore chelim shennitmeu bemashkin, rabbi eliezer omer: metammein et hammashkin veen poslin et hoovchalin. metammein et hammashkin, vaafillu dechullin, veen poslin et hoovchalin, vaafillu ditruma. rabbi yehoshua omer: metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et hoovchalin.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: kal vachomer, uma tevul yom sheen metamme mashke chullin, posel ochle teruma, achore chelim shemmetamme mashke chullin, eno din shepposel ochle teruma?
Verabbi eliezer, achore chelim derabbanan, utevul yom deorayyta, verabbanan middeorayyta la avdinan kal vachomer, demiddeorayyta en ochel metamme keli, veen mashke metamme keli.
Verabbanan hu digzur gezera, mishshum mashkin dezav vezava, mashkin daalulin lekabbel tumea — gezaru behu rabbanan, ovchalin deen alulin lekabbel tumea — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Umay shena achore chelim denaket? mishshum dekilli, ditnan: keli shennitma meachorav bemashkin — achorav tame, tocho, ozno, ogno, yadav — tehorin. nitma tocho — kullo tame.
May ka mashma lan shemuel? bechullehu tenan hilcheta!
Vechi tema, achore chelim ka mashma lan dela tenan, velema halacha kerabbi eliezer baachore chelim! ella ha ka mashma lan, sheen lemedin halacha mippi talmud.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer:

a: Melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer! ki amar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa beseder teharot, aval bishar sedarim ikka tuva.
Vehachi name mistabbera, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: af harode venoten lassal, hassal metzarfan lachalla. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer. shema minna.
Umay ulemeh dehay mehay? mishshum dekae rabbi elazar kevateh.
Ditnan: rabbi elazar omer: melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo.
Umi kae? veha atzroche matzrechinan lehu, vela damyayn lahadade! ella, mishshum dekae rabbi yehuda ben bava kevateh.
Detanya, rabbi yehuda ben bava heid chamishsha devarim: shemmemaanim et hakketannot.

Veshemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad, veshenniskal tarnegol birushalayim al sheharag et hannefesh, veal yayin ben arbaim yom shennitnassech al gabbe hammizbeach, veal tamid shel shachar shekkarav bearba shaot.
May ketannot? lav chada derabbi elazar, vechad derabbi eliezer? la, may ketannot? ketannot dealma.
I hachi, gabbe ishsha name, nitne "nashim" venema nashim dealma! ella, middehacha katane "ishsha", vehacha katane "ketannot", shema minna davka katane. shema minna.

Vechen amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa. vetu lekka? vehatnan: rabbi eliezer omer melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo, veamar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi eliezer! vechi tema: ki amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa beseder teharot, aval bishar sidre ikka. umi ikka?
Vehatnan: havvered, vehakkofer, vehalletom, vehakketaf — yesh lahen sheviit, velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahen biur, velidmehen biur. veamar rabbi pedat: man tena kitfa pera? rabbi eliezer.
Veamar rabbi zera: chazi deminnach umeavuch kasharetu kitfa lealma! at amrat: man tanna kitfa pera? rabbi eliezer, vaavuch amar: halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa.
Veim ita, lema leh: ki amar abba halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa beseder teharot, aval bishar sidre ikka.
Ella kashya hahi! mishshum dekae rabbi elazar kevateh, ditnan: rabbi elazar omer: melammedim et hakketanna shettemaen bo.
Umi kae, veha atzroche matzrechinan lehu, vela damyayn lahadade! ella mishshum dekae rabbi yehuda ben bava kevavteh.
Vetu lekka? vehatnan: rabbi akiva omer: omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah, rabbi eliezer omer: omrah bahodaa, veamar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi eliezer!
Amar rabbi abba: hahu deamar mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel, detanya: rabbi akiva omer: omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah, rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: omrah bahodaa.
b: Veha kashshish minneh tuva! ella mishshum dekae rabbi chanina ben gamliel beshitteh.

Umi kae? vehatanya: or yom hakkippurim — mitpallel sheva umitvadde, shacharit — mitpallel sheva umitvadde, musaf — mitpallel sheva umitvadde, mincha — mitpallel sheva umitvadde, binila — mitpallel sheva umitvadde, bearvit — mitpallel sheva meen shemone esre.

Rabbi chanina ben gamliel mishshum avotav omer: mitpallel shemone esre, mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ihu amar mishshum avotav, veleh la sevira leh.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: veat la tisbera deman tena kitfa pera rabbi eliezer hu? vehatnan: rabbi eliezer omer: hammaamid bisraf arla asur!

Afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella bekitfa digvavza, aval bekitfa defera modu leh, ditnan: amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati beferush shehammaamid bisraf healin bisraf haikkarin muttar, bisraf happaggin asur, mippene shehu peri.

Veibbaet ema: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer — beilan haose perot, aval beilan sheeno ose perot — modu diktafo zehu piryo. ditnan: rabbi shimon omer: en lakketaf sheviit, vachachamim omrim: yesh lakketaf sheviit, mippene shekketafo zehu piryo.
Man chachamim? lav rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi eliezer? amar leh hahu sava: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: man chachamim? rabbi eliezer, deamar: ketafo zehu piryo.

I rabbi eliezer, may irya ilan sheeno ose peri? afillu ilan haose peri — ketafo zehu piryo! ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi, afillu ilan haose perot name — ketafo zehu piryo. ledidchu, odo li mihat beilan sheeno ose perot diktafo zehu piryo. verabbanan amri leh: la shena.

Ezo hi betula? kol shello raata kulei. tanu rabbanan: nisset veraata dam mechamat nissuin, yalda veraata dam mechamat leda — adayin ani kore lah "betula", shehare "betula" sheamru — betulat damim, velo betulat betulim.
Ini? vehaamar rav kahana: tena, shalosh betulot hen — betulat adam, betulat karka, betulat shikma. betulat adam — kol zeman shello nivala, nafka minna lechohen gadol, i name lichtubbatah matayim.
Betulat karka — kol zeman shello neevda. nafka minna lenachal etan, i name lemikkach umimkar.
Betulat shikma — kol zeman shello niktzetza. nafka minna lemikkach umimkar, i name lemiktzetza bishviit, keditnan: en kotztzin betulat shikma bashsheviit mippene shehi avoda. veim ita, litne name ha!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ki katane midde delet leh shem levavy, aval midde deit leh shem levavy — la katane. rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: ki katane midde ditle bemaase, midde dela tele bemaase — la katane.

Rabbi chanina bereh derav ika amar: ki katane midde dela hadar livriyyayto, midde dehadar livriyyayto la katane. ravina amar: ki katane midde dekafed aleh zavona, midde dela kafed aleh zavona la katane.

Vela kafdi? vehatanya: rabbi chiyyay omer: keshem shehasseor yafe laissa, kach damim yafin laishsha. vetanya mishshum rabbi meir: kol ishsha sheddameha merubbin — baneha merubbin! ella, ki katane — midde dekafetz aleh zavona, midde dela kafetz aleh zavona — la katane.
Tanu rabbanan: ezohi "betulat karka"? kol shemmaala reshushin, veen afarah tichuach. nimtza bah cheres — beyadua shenneevda. tzunema — hare zo "betulat karka".

Meubberet — mishsheyyivvada ubbarah. vechamma hakkarat haubbar? somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: shelosha chodashim, veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vayhi kemishlosh chodashim vegomer".
Zecher laddavar? kera ketiv, ureaya gedola hi! mishshum deikka deyalda letisha, veikka deyalda leshiva.
Tanu rabbanan: hare shehayta bechezkat meubberet, veraata dam, veachar kach hippila ruach o kol davar sheeno shel keyayma — hare hi bechezkatah, vedayya sheatah.
Veaf al gav sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "harinu chalnu kemo yaladnu ruach". may zecher laddavar? hare reaya gedola hi! ki ketiv hay kera, bizcharim ketiv.
Ureminhi: kishsheta shenayim, velashshelishi hippila ruach o kol davar sheeno shel keyayma — hare zo yoledet bezov, vei amrat leda meallayyta hi,

a: Koshi samuch lalleda rachamana tahareh! amar rav pappe: hannach meet leet derabbanan.
Rav pappa amar: middi hu tama ella mishshum deroshah kaved aleha veevareha kevedin aleha, hacha name roshah veevareha kevedin aleha.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: raata, veachar kach hukkar ubbarah, mahu? kevan dividdana dachazay lo hukkar ubbarah — metammeya, o dilma, kevan dismivch la chazay — la metammeya?
Amar leh: middi hu tama ella mishshum deroshah kaved aleha veevareha kevedin aleha? beiddana dachazay — en roshah kaved aleha veen evareha kevedin aleha.

Bea minneh hahu sava merabbi yochanan: higgia et vistah bime ibburah velo badka, mahu? ka mibbaya li allibba deman deamar vesatot deorayyta. may? kevan divsatot deorayyta baaya bedika, o dilma kevan dedameha mesullakin la baaya bedika?

Amar leh: tenetuha, rabbi meir omer: im hayta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka — tehora, shecharada mesalleket et haddamim. tama deikka charada, ha lekka charada vehiggia vistah velo badka — temea.
Alma vesatot deorayyta, vechevan deikka charada — dameha mesullakin, vela baaya bedika. hacha name — dameha mesullakin, vela baaya bedika.

Menika ad shettigmol vechulei. tanu rabbanan: menika shemmet benah betoch esrim vearba chodesh — hare hi kechol hannashim, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida. lefichach, im hayta menikato veholechet arba o chamesh shanim — dayyah sheatah, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: dayyayn sheatan kol esrim vearba chodesh, lefichach im hayta menikato arba vechamesh shanim — metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Keshettimmatze lomar, ledivre rabbi meir — dam nekar venaasa chalav, ledivre rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — evareha mitparkin, veen nafshah chozeret ad esrim vearba chodesh.
"Lefichach" derabbi meir lema li? mishshum "lefichach" derabbi yose.
Ulefichach" derabbi yose lema li? mahu detema rabbi yose tarte it leh, ka mashma lan.

Tanya name hachi: dam nekar venaasa chalav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: evareha mitparkin, veen nafshah chozeret aleha ad esrim vearba chodesh. amar rabbi ilay: may tama derabbi meir? dichtiv: "mi yitten tahor mittame lo echad".
Verabbanan? amar rabbi yochanan: zo shichvat zera, shehu — tame, veadam hannotzer mimmennu — tahor.
Verabbi elazar omer: ellu me hannidda, shehammazze umazzin alav — tahor, venogea — tame. umazze tahor? vehachtiv: "umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav"! may "mazze"? — nogea.
Vehachtiv "mazze", vehachtiv "nogea"! veod, "mazze" bae kibbus, "nogea" la bae kibbus! ella, may "mazze"? nose.
Velichtov "nose"! ka mashma lan dead dedare keshiur hazzaa. hanicha leman deamar hazzaa tzericha shiur, ella leman deamar en tzericha shiur, may ikka lememar?
Afillu leman deamar enah tzericha shiur, hane mille — aggabba degavra, aval bemana — baenan shiur. keditnan: kamma yihyu bammayim vihe bahen kede hazzaa? kede sheyyitbol rashe givolin veyazze.
Vehayeynu deamar shelomo: "amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni".
Ezo hi zekena? kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot [samuch leziknatah]. hechi dame samuch leziknatah? amar rav yehuda: kol shechavroteha omrot aleha "zekena hi". verabbi shimon omer:
b: Kol shekkorin lah "imma imma" veenah bosha. rabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak — chad amar: kol sheenah makpedet, vechad amar: kol sheenah bosha. may venayyhu? ikka venayyhu: bosha veenah makpedet.

Vechamma ona? amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: ona benonit sheloshim yom, verava amar rav chisda: esrim yom. vela peligi, mar kachashev yeme tumea vime tohora, umar la chashev yeme tumea.

Tanu rabbanan: zekena sheavru aleha shalosh onot, veraata — dayyah sheatah. veod avru aleha shalosh onot, veraata — dayyah sheatah. veod avru aleha shalosh onot, veraata — hare hi kechol hannashim, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Vela (mibbaya) shekkivvevna, ella afillu pichata, vaafillu hotira.
"Afillu pichata", vela mibbaaya kivvevna? adderabba, ki kivvevna — kava lah vistah, vedayya sheatah!
Vechi tema, rabbanan hi, difligi aleh derabbi dosa, deamri: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset metammea meet leet, ippecha mibbee leh, velema: velo sheppichata vehotira, ella afillu kivvevna!
Teni: lo sheppichata vehotira, ella afillu kivvevna. veibbaet ema, hachi kaamar: velo shekkivvevna, ella sheppichata vehotira, aval kivvevna — kava lah veset, vedayya sheatah. umanni? rabbi dosa hi.

Rabbi eliezer omer: kol ishsha sheavru aleha vechulei. tanya: amar lahem rabbi eliezer lachachamim: maase beriva achat behayetalo, shehifsika shalosh onot, uva maase lifne chachamim veamru: dayyah sheatah.
Amru lo: en sheat haddechak reaya. may sheat haddechak? ikka deamri: shene vatztzoret havo, ikka deamri: teharot appesh (laavida) [vaavada], vechashshu rabbanan lehefsed ditharot.

Tanu rabbanan: maase, veasa rabbi kerabbi eliezer. leachar shennizkar, amar: keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak. may "leachar shennizkar"? illema leachar shennizkar deen halacha kerabbi eliezer ella kerabbanan, bishat haddechak hechi aved kevavteh?

Ella, dela ittemar hilcheta la kemar valo kemar, umay "leachar shennizkar"? leachar shennizkar delav yachid pelig aleh, ella rabbim peligi aleh, amar: keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
Tanu rabbanan: tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veraata, paam rishona — dayyah sheatah, sheniyya — dayyah sheatah, shelishit — hare hi kechol hannashim, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.

Avru aleha shalosh onot veraata — dayyah sheatah, veod avru aleha shalosh onot veraata — dayyah sheatah, veod avru aleha shalosh onot veraata — hare hi kechol hannashim, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Ucheshehiggia zemannah lirot, paam rishona — dayyah sheatah, sheniyya — metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida, avru aleha shalosh onot veraata — dayyah sheatah.
Amar mar: avru aleha shalosh onot — dayyah sheatah.

a: Hadar kachazya beonot, may? amar rav giddel amar rav: paam rishona usheniyya — dayyah sheatah, shelishit — metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Veod avru aleha shalosh onot, veraata — dayyah sheatah. hadar kachazya beonot, may?
Amar rav kahana, amar rav giddel, amar rav: paam rishona — dayyah sheatah, sheniyya — metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Manni? rabbi hi, deamar: bitre zimne have chazaka.
Ema sefa: avru aleha shalosh onot veraata — dayyah sheatah, atan lerabbi eliezer!
Vechi tema rabbi hi, uveonot savar la kerabbi eliezer, umi savar la? veha leachar shennizkar kaamar! ella rabbi eliezer hi, uvivsatot savar la kerabbi.

Ketem shebben rishona usheniyya — tahor, shebben sheniyya ushelishit — chizkiyya amar: tame, rabbi yochanan amar: tahor. chizkiyya amar: tame, kevan deillu chazya metammea — kitma name tame, verabbi yochanan amar: tahor, kevan dela ittachzaka bedam — kitma name la metammenan la.
b: Matkef la rabbi ilay: vechi ma ben zo livtula sheddameha tehorin? amar leh rabbi zera: zo sirfah matzuy vezo en sirfah matzuy.

Amar ulla, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot, veraata paam rishona usheniyya — rukkah umidrasah bashshuk tahor, kitmah name tahor. vela yadana im dideh, im derabbeh.
Lemay nafka minna? lemihve devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Ki ata ravin vechol nachote yamma, amruha kerabbi shimon ben yehotzadak.
Amar rav chilkiyya bar tove: tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot, afillu shofaat kol shiva — enah ella reaya achat. afillu shofaat, vela mibbaya poseket? adderabba, poseket havya la kishte reiyyot!
Ella, tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot, veshofaat kol shiva — enah ella reaya achat.
Amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: madlefet enah keroa, veha kachazya! ema: enah keshofaat, ella kefoseket.
Mikkelal deshofaat (name) ki nahara? ella ema: enah ella keshofaat.
Tanu rabbanan: chazaka benot yisrael ad shello higgiu lefirkan — hare hen bechezkat tohora, veen hannashim bodkot otan. mishshehiggiu lefirkan — hare hen bechezkat tumea, venashim bodkot otan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: en bodkin otan bayyad, mippene shemmeavvevtot otan, ella sachot otan beshemen mibbifnim, umekannechot otan mibbachutz, vehen nivdakot meelehen.
Rabbi yose omer: meubberet vechulei. tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar: rabbi yose omer: meubberet umenika sheavru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah. amar leh: petacht bitre" vesayyemt bachada"!

Dilma meubberet vehi menika kaamrat, umilleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan — dime ibburah olin lah lime menikutah, vime menikutah olin lah lime ibburah. kidtanya: yeme ibburah olin lah lime menikutah, vime menikutah olin lah lime ibburah.

Ketzad? hifsika shetayim bime ibburah, veachat bime menikutah; shetayim bime menikutah, veachat bime ibburah; achat umechetza bime ibburah, veachat umechetza bime menikutah — mitztarfot leshalosh onot.
Bishlama yeme ibburah olin lah lime menikutah, mashkachat la dekamnika veazla umiabbera, ella yeme menikutah olin lah lime ibburah, hechi mashkachat la?
Ibbaet ema: beleda yabbishta, veibbaet ema: dam nidda lechod vedam leda lechod, veibbaet ema: teni chada.
Bamme amru dayyah sheatah vechulei. amar rav: akkullehu.
Ushemuel amar: lo shanu ella betula uzekena, aval meubberet umenika — dayyayn kol yeme ibburan, dayyayn kol yeme menikutan.

Vechen amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: akkullehu, verabbi yochanan amar: lo shanu ella betula uzekena, aval meubberet umenika — dayyayn kol yeme ibburan, dayyayn kol yeme menikutan. ketannae: meubberet umenika shehayu

a: Shofot dam uvaot — dayyayn kol yeme ibburan vedayyayn kol yeme menikutan, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim: lo amru dayyayn sheatan ella biriyyay rishona, aval bashsheniyya metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida.
Veim raata rishona vechulei. amar rav huna: kaftza veraata, kaftza veraata, kaftza veraata — kava lah veset. lemay? ilema leyamim, ha kol yoma dela kefitz la chazay!
Ella likfitzot, vehatanya: kol shettikbaenna mechamat ones, afillu kamma peamim — lo kava veset! may lav — lo kava veset kelal?

La, lo kava veset leyamim lechodayyhu velikfitzot lechodayyhu, aval kava lah veset leyamim velikfitzot. leyamim lechodayyhu peshita! amar rav ashe: kegon dikfitz bechad beshabbat vachazay, ukefitz bechad beshabbat vachazay, uveshabbat kefatza vela chazay, ulechad beshabbat chazay bela kefitza.
Mahu detema: iggallay milleta lemafrea, deyoma hu dekagarem vela kefitza, ka mashma lan dikfitza name deetmol gerama, vehay dela chazay — mishshum deakkatti la meta zeman kefitza.

Lishshana acharina, amar rav huna: kaftza veraata, kaftza veraata, kaftza veraata — kava lah veset leyamim velo likfitzot. hechi dame? amar rav ashe: dikfitz bechad beshabbat vachazay, ukefitz bechad beshabbat vachazay, uveshabbat kefatza vela chazay, ulechad beshabbat (acharina) chazay bela kefitza, dehatam iggallay milleta deyoma hu deka garem.
Mishna af al pi sheamru dayyah sheatah, tzericha lihyot bodeket, chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar.
Umeshammeshet beedim, chutz miyyoshevet al dam tohar, uvetula sheddameha tehorim.

Ufeamim tzericha lihyot bodeket: shacharit, uven hashshemashot, uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah. yeterot alehen kohanot, beshaa shehen ochlot bitruma. rabbi yehuda omer: af bishat avaratan milleechol bitruma.
Gemara chutz min hannidda. divtoch yeme niddatah la bae bedika.

Hanicha lerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar: ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah, veen ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah — shappir. ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar: ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah — tivdok, dilma kava la veset!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: ki amena ana — hecha dachazeteh mimmayan satum, aval chazeteh mimmayan patuach — la amari.
Vehayyoshevet al dam tohar, ka salka datach — mevakkeshet leshev al dam tohar.
Hanicha lerav, deamar: mayan echad hu, hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu — shappir.
Ella lelevi deamar: shene mayanot hem, tivdok, dilma akkatti la pesak hahu mayan tame! amar lach levi: ha manni?
b: Bet shammay hi, deamri: mayan echad hu. usetam lan tanna kevet shammay?! setam veachar kach machloket hu, vechol setam veachar kach machloket en halacha kistam.
Vei baet ema: mi katane "mevakkeshet leshev"? "yoshevet" katane! i yoshevet, may lememra? mahu detema tivdok, dedilma kava la veset — ka mashma lan demayan tahor lemayan tame la kava.
Hanicha lelevi, deamar: shene mayanot hem, ella lerav deamar: mayan echad hu — tivdok, dilma kava la veset! afillu hachi, mime tohora lime tumea la kava.
Umeshammeshet beedim vechulei. tenan hatam: tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim: notnin lah arba lelot, uvet hillel omrim: ad shettichye hammakka.
Amar rav giddel, amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shello paska mechamat tashmish veraata shello mechamat tashmish, aval paska mechamat tashmish veraata — temea.
Avar layla achat belo tashmish veraata — temea. nishtannu mare damim shellah — temea. metiv rabbi yona: "uvetula sheddameha tehorim", ammay? teshammesh beedim, dedilma nishtannu mare damim shellah!
Amar rava: ema resha "chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar", hu dela baaya bedika, aval betula sheddameha tehorin baaya bedika. ella kashyayn ahadade!
Kan — sheshshimmesha, deema shammash acharan; kan — shello shimmesha.
Tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim? shello paska mechamat tashmish, veraata shello mechamat tashmish.
Aval paska mechamat tashmish veraata — temea, avar layla achat belo tashmish veraata — temea, nishtannu mare damim shellah — temea.
Paamayim hi tzericha vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella litharot, aval levalah mutteret. peshita, "shacharit" tenan!

Ella i ittemar assefa ittemar: uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella beishsha asuka bitharot, demiggo devaaya bedika litharot — baaya name bedika levalah, aval enah asuka bitharot — la baaya bedika.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levaalehen! i mimmatnitin hava amena, hane mille beishsha sheyyesh lah veset, aval ishsha sheen lah veset — baaya bedika.

Veha matnitin beishsha sheyyesh lah veset askinan! matnitin ben sheyyesh lah veset, ben en lah veset, veha ka mashma lan: deaf al gav deyesh lah veset, miggo devaaya bedika litharot, baaya name bedika levalah.

Veha amra shemuel chada zimna! deamar rabbi zera, amar rabbi abba bar yirmeya, amar shemuel: ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok. veokimna baasuka bitharot! chada mikkelal chaverta ittemar.

Tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim — litharot, aval levalah mutteret. bamme devarim amurim — shehinnichah bechezkat tehora, aval hinnichah bechezkat temea — leolam hi betumeatah ad shettomar lo "tehora ani".

a: Bea minneh rabbi zera merav yehuda: ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah levalah? amar leh: lo tivdok. vetivdok — uma bechach? im ken — libbo nokfo uforesh.
Bea minneh rabbi abba merav huna: ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah keshiur veset, kede lechayyev balah chattat?
Amar leh: mi mashkachat la livdika keshiur veset? vehatanya: ezehu shiur veset? mashal leshammash vaed sheomdim betzad hammashkof, bitziat hashshammash nichnas ed.
Heve: veset sheamru — lekinnuach, velo livdika. ella mahu shettekanneach?
Ikka deamri, hachi bea minneh: ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah kede lechayyev balah asham taluy? amar lo: lo tivdok. vetivdok, uma bechach? im ken, libbo nokfo uforesh.

Uveshaa shehi overet vechulei. amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yannay: vezehu iddan shel tzenuot. amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme: tanna tane "tzerichot", veat tane "tzenuot"! amar leh: sheani omer kol hamekayyem divre chachamim nikra "tzanua".

Amar rava: vesheeno mekayyem divre chachamim — "tzanua" hu dela mikkere, ha "rasha" la mikkere? ella amar rava: tzenuot — ad shebbadku bo atzman lifne tashmish ze, en bodkot bo lifne tashmish acher, vesheenan tzenuot — bodkot velo ichpat lahen.

Gufa, amar rabbi zera, amar rabbi abba bar yirmeya, amar shemuel: ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi abba bar yirmeya: en lah veset — baaya bedika, yesh lah veset — la baaya bedika?
Amar leh: yesh lah veset — era baaya bedika, yeshena la baaya bedika; en lah veset — ben era ben yeshena baaya bedika.

Amar rava: velema leh — yesh lah veset, litharot baaya bedika, levalah la baaya bedika; en lah veset, afillu levalah name baaya bedika. umiddela amar leh hachi, shema minna kasavar shemuel: kol levala la baaya bedika.

Tanu rabbanan: chammarin ufoalin, vehabbain mibbet haevel umibbet hammishte — neshehem lahem bechezkat tohora, uvain veshohin immahem, ben yeshenot ben erot. bamme devarim amurim? shehinnichan bechezkat tohora, aval hinnichan bechezkat tumea — leolam hi temea, ad shettomar lo "tehora ani".
Veha shemuel bemay moke la? i besheyyesh lah veset — kashya era, vei besheen lah veset — kashya ben era ben yeshena!
Leolam besheyyesh lah veset, vechevan shettevaah — en lecha bedika gedola mizzo. amar leh rav pappa lerava: mahu lemebad ki ha matnita?
b: Amar leh: sudani, la, demigganya beappeh. amar rav kahana: sheeltinhu leinashe beteh derav pappa uderav huna bereh derav yehoshua, ki ato rabbanan mibbe rav matzrechi lechu bedika? vaamaru li: la. velishayyeylinhu ledidhu! dilma inhu ka machmeyri annafshayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: ishsha sheen lah veset — asura leshammesh, veen lah lo ketubba, velo perot, velo mezonot, velo belaot, umotzi velo machzir olamit, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: meshammeshet bishne iddim, hen ivvetuha, hen tikkenuha. mishshum abba chanan amru: oy lo levalah.
Asura leshammesh — dilma mekalkela leh. veen lah ketubba — kevan dela chazya levia, let la ketubba.
Velo perot, velo mezonot, velo belaot — tenae ketubba kichtubba damu.
Veyotzi, velo yachzir olamit. peshita! la tzericha — dahadara veittakkana. mahu detema layhdera? ka mashma lan, dezimnin deazla uminnasva umittakna.
Veamar: "illu hayiti yodea shekkach haya, afillu heyitem notnin li mea mane — lo hayiti megarshah!", venimtza get batel, uvaneha mamzerin.
Mishshum abba chanan amru: "oy lo levalah". ikka deamri lerabbi meir amar leh, devae leagboya ketubbeta. ikka deamri lerabbi chanina ben antignos kaamar leh, dimkalkela leh.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos. uvemay? i baasuka bitharot, ha amra shemuel chada zimna!

Vei besheenah asuka bitharot, ha amar kol levala la baaya bedika, deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi abba bar yirmeya amar shemuel: "ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok", veokimna lah baasuka bitharot! man dematne ha la matne ha.
Hadaran alach shammay omer.

a: Mishna kol hayyad hammarba livdok bannashim — meshubbachat, uvaanashim — tikkatzetz.
Gemara may shena nashim, umay shena anashim? nashim lav benot haregasha ninhu — meshubbachot, anashim divne haregasha ninhu — tikkatzetz.
I hachi may irya marba? ki lo marba name! ki katane "marba" — anashim.
Tana: bamme devarim amurim? leinyan shichvat zera, aval leinyan zov — af hu meshubbach kannashim.
Vaafillu leinyan shichvat zera, im ba livdok bitzror o becheres — bodek.
Uvematlet la? vehatanya: bodek atzmo bematlet uvechol davar sherotze! kidamar abbaye: bematlet ava, hacha name bematlet ava.
Vehecha ittemar deabbaye? aha ditnan: haya ochel bitruma, vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav — ochez beammato, uvolea et hatteruma.
Ochez? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer omer: kol haochez beammato umashtin — keillu mevi mabbul laolam! amar abbaye: bematlet ava.
Rava amar: afillu tema bematlet rakka, kevan daakar — akar, veabbaye chayesh dilma ate leosofe, verava la chayesh dilma ate leosofe.
Vela? vehatanya: ha lema ze dome? lenoten etzba baayin, shekkol zeman sheetzba baayin — ayin madmaat vechozeret umadmaat!
Verava, kol ichammome vahadar ichammome beshateh — la shechiach.

Gufa, rabbi eliezer omer: kol haochez baamma umashtin keillu mevi mabbul laolam. amru lo lerabbi eliezer: vahalo nitztzotzot nittazin al raglav, venire kichrut shofcha, venimtza motzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim!
Amar lahen: mutav sheyyotzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim, veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom.
Tanya iddach: amar lahen rabbi eliezer lachachamim, efshar yaamod adam bemakom gavoah veyashtin, o yashtin beafar tichuach, veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom.
He amar lehu beresha? illema kammayyta amar lehu beresha, batar deamar lehu issura hadar amar lehu takkanta?!
Ella, ha amar lehu beresha, vaamaru leh: en lo makom gavoah veafar tichuach, may? amar lahen: mutav sheyyotzi laaz al banav, veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom.

Vechol kach lamma? mippene shemmotzi shichvat zera levattala, deamar rabbi yochanan: kol hammotzi shichvat zera levattala chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "vayyera beene Adonai (et) asher asa vayyamet gam oto".

Rabbi yitzchak verabbi amme amri: keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "hannechamim baelim tachat kol etz raanan shochate hayeladim bannechalim tachat seife hasselaim", al tikre "shochate" ella "sochate".
Rav assi amar: keillu oved avoda zara, ketiv hacha "tachat kol etz raanan", uchetiv hatam "al heharim haramim vetachat kol etz raanan".
Rav yehuda ushemuel havo kayymi aiggara deve kenishta deshaf vitev binhardea. amar leh rav yehuda lishmuel: tzarich ani lehashetin. amar leh: shinnana, echoz baamatcha vehasheten lachutz.
Hechi aved hachi? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer omer: kol haochez beammato umashtin — keillu mevi mabbul laolam!

Amar abbaye: asao kevoleshet, ditnan: boleshet (shennichnas) [shennichnesa] lair, bishat shalom — chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot, bishat milchama — ellu veellu muttarot, lefi sheen lahen penay lenassech. alma: dechevan diviti la ate lenassoche, hacha name: kevan diviti la ate leharehore.

Vehacha may beituta ikka? ibbaet ema: biatuta delelya udeiggara, veibbaet ema: biatuta derabbeh, veibbaet ema: biatuta dishchina, veibbaet ema: emta demareh aleh, dekare shemuel aleh: "en ze yelud ishsha".
Veibbaet ema: nasuy hava, deamar rav nachman: im haya nasuy — muttar.

Veibbaet ema, ki ha ori leh, detane abba bereh derabbi binyamin bar chiyyay: aval mesayyea babbetzim millematta. veibbaet ema, ki ha ori leh, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: gevul yesh lo, meatara ulematta – muttar,
b: Meatara ulemala — asur.

Amar rav: hamekashshe atzmo ledaat — yehe benidduy. velema "asur"! dekamgare yetzer hara annafsheh. verabbi amme amar: nikra "avaryayn", shekkach ummanuto shel yetzer hara: hayyom omer lo "ase kach", ulemachar omer lo "ase kach", ulemachar omer lo "lech avod avoda zara" — veholech veoved.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi amme: kol hammevi atzmo lide hirhur — en machnisin oto bimchitzato shel hakkadosh baruch hu. ketiv hacha: "vayyera beene Adonai", uchetiv hatam: "ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra".
Veamar rabbi elazar: may dichtiv "yedechem damim maleu"? ellu hamenaafim bayyad. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "lo tinaf" — lo tehe (becha niuf) [noef], ben bayyad ben baregel.

Tanu rabbanan: haggerim vehamesachakin betinokot — meakkevin et hammashiach. bishlama gerim — kidrabbi chelbo, deamar rabbi chelbo: "kashin gerim leyisrael kesappachat", ella mesachakin battinokot may hi?
Ilema mishkav zechur — bene sekila ninhu! ella derech evarim — bene mabbul ninhu!
Ella denasyvi ketannot, delav benot olode ninhu, deamar rabbi yose: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol hanneshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti".
Baanashim tikkatzetz. ibbaya lehu: dina tenan o latuta tenan? dina tenan, ki ha derav huna katz yeda, o latuta tenan?

Ta shema, detanya: rabbi tarfon omer: yad laamma — tikkatzetz yado al tabburo. amru lo: yashav lo kotz bichreso, lo yittelennu?! amar lahen: lo. vahalo kereso nivkaat! amar lahen: mutav tibbaka kereso, veal yered liver shachat.
I amrat bishlama dina tenan, hayeynu deamri: "vahalo kereso nivkaat", ella i amrat latuta tenan, may "kereso nivkaat"? ella may dina tenan, la saggi delav al tabburo?

Ella hachi kaamar rabbi tarfon: kol hammachnis yado lematta mittabburo — tikkatzetz. amru lo lerabbi tarfon: yashav lo kotz bichreso lo yittelennu?! amar lahen: lo. vahalo kereso nivkaat! amar lahen: mutav tibbaka kereso, veal yered liver shachat.
Mishna hachereshet, vehashshota, vehassoma, veshennitrefa datah — im yesh lahem pikkechot, metakkenot otan, vehen ochlot bitruma.
Gemara chereshet — ihi tivdok lenafsha! detanya, amar rabbi: chereshet hayta bishchunatenu, lo dayya shebbodeket leatzmah, ella shechavroteha root umarot lah!
Hatam — bimdabberet veenah shomaat, hacha — besheenah medabberet veenah shomaat, keditnan: cheresh sheddibberu chachamim bechol makom — eno shomea veeno medabber.
Hassoma — ihi tivdok lenafsha, vetaychze lachavirta! amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: soma enah mishna.
Veshennitrefa datah — hayeynu shota! shennitrefa datah mechamat choli.
Tanu rabbanan: kohen shote — matbilin oto, umaachilin oto teruma laerev, umeshammerin oto shello yishan. yashan — tame, lo yashan — tahor.
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: osin lo kis shel or. amru lo: kol shekken shemmevi lide chimmum! amar lahen: ledivrechem, shote en lo takkana.
Amru lo: lidvarenu — yashan tame, lo yashan tahor; lidvarecha — shemma yire tippa kechardal, vetibbala bakkis!
Tana mishshum rabbi elazar amru: osin lo kis shel mattechet.
Amar abbaye: veshel nechoshet, kidtanya: rabbi yehuda omer: roin otan givolin shel ezov keillu hen shel nechoshet.
Amar rav pappa: shema minna michnasayim asurim, vehachtiv: "vaase lahem michnese vad lechassot besar erva"!
Hahu, kidtanya: michnese chohanim lema hen domin? kemin pemalanya shel parashim, lemala — ad motnayim, lematta — ad yerechayim, veyesh lahem shenatzim, veen lahem lo bet hannekev velo bet haerva.
Amar abbaye:

a: Rochve gemallim asurin leechol bitruma. tanya name hachi: rochve gemallim — kullam reshaim, hassappanim — kullam tzaddikim,
Hachammarim — mehen reshaim mehen tzaddikim. ikka deamri: ha demikkaf, ha dela mikkaf; veikka deamri: ha dimtarten, ha dela metarten.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi layet amman degane apparkid. ini? vehaamar rav yosef: perakdan lo yikra "keriyyat shema" — keriyyat shema hu delo yikra, ha migna shappir dame!
Leinyan migna, ki matzle — shappir dame. leinyan keriat shema, ki matzle — asur. veha rabbi yochanan matzle vekare keriat shema! shane rabbi yochanan, devaal basar hava.
Mishna derech benot yisrael meshammeshot bishne edim, echad lo veechad lah, vehatztzenuot metakkenot shelishi letakken et habbayit.
Nimtza al shello — temein vechayyayvin korban. nimtza al shellah otyom — temein vechayyayvin bekorban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman — temein missafek, ufeturin min hakkorban.
Ezehu achar zeman? kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha, veachar kach metammea meet leet, veenah metammea et boalah. rabbi akiva omer: af metammea et boalah.
Modim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa ketem shemmetammea et boalah.
Gemara venechush dilma dam maacholet hu? amar rabbi zera: oto makom baduk hu etzel maacholet. veikka deamri: dachuk hu etzel maacholet.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deishtechach maacholet retzufa. lehach lishshana deamar "baduk hu" — ha mealma atay, lehach lishshana deamar "dachuk hu" — ema shammash retzafah.
Ittemar: badka beed habbaduk lah, vetachattu birechah, ulemachar matzata alav dam. amar rav: temea nidda. amar leh rav shimi bar chiyyay: veha "chosheshet" amart lan!
Ittemar name, amar shemuel: temea nidda. vechen morin be midresha: temea nidda.
Ittemar: badka beed sheeno baduk lah, vehinnichattu bekufesa, ulemachar matza alav dam. amar rav yosef: kol yamav shel rabbi chiyyay timme, uleet ziknato tiher.
Ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? kol yamav timme mishshum nidda, uleet ziknato tiher mishshum nidda, vetimme mishshum ketem.
O dilma: kol yamav timme mishshum ketem, uleet ziknato tiher mivvelo kelum?
Ta shema, detanya: badka beed sheeno baduk lah, vehinnichattu bekufesa, ulemachar matza alav dam, rabbi omer: temea mishshum nidda, verabbi chiyyay amar: temea mishshum ketem.
b: Amar lo rabbi chiyyay: i atta mode shetztzericha kigris veod? amar lo: aval. amar lo: im ken, af atta asito ketem.
Verabbi savar: baenan "kigris veod" leappoke middam maacholet, vechevan dinfak la middam maacholet — vadday miggufa ata.
May lav beziknuto kae? ha beyalduto timme mishshum nidda! shema minna.
Mishtabbach leh rabbi lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose berabbi chama bar besa, deadam gadol hu. amar lo: lichsheyyavo leyadcha, haviehu leyadi.
Ki ata, amar leh: bei minnay milleta. bea minneh: badka beed sheeno baduk lah, vehinnichattu bekufesa, ulemachar matza alav dam, mahu?
Amar lo: kedivre abba ema lach, o kedivre rabbi ema lach? amar leh: kedivre rabbi ema li.
Amar rabbi yishmael: zehu sheomrin alav deadam gadol hu? heach mannichin divre harav veshomin divre hattalmid?!
Verabbi chama bar besa savar: rabbi resh metivta hu, ushechichi rabbanan kammeh, umechaddedi shematateh.
May rabbi, umay rabbi yose? amar rav adda bar matna, tana: rabbi metamme, verabbi yose metaher.
Veamar rabbi zera: keshettimme rabbi — kerabbi meir, ucheshettiher rabbi yose — leatzmo tiher.
Detanya: haishsha shehayta osa tzeracheha veraata dam, rabbi meir omer: im omedet — temea, im yoshevet — tehora.
Rabbi yose omer: ben kach uven kach — tehora.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, keshettimme rabbi meir lo timme ella mishshum ketem, veillu rabbi mishshum nidda kaamar! amar leh: anan hachi kaamrinan, ki ittemar hahi mishshum nidda ittemar.
Nimtza al shellah otyom temein vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezehu shiur veset? mashal leshammash vaed sheomdin betzad hammashkof, bitziat shammash nichnas ed.
Heve veset sheamru lekinnuach, aval lo livdika.
Nimtza al shellah leachar zeman vechulei. tana: vechayyayvin asham taluy. vetanna didan, may tama?
Baenan chaticha mishte chatichot.
Ezehu "achar zeman" vechulei. ureminhi: ezehu "acher zeman"? peresh rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok: kede shettoshit yadah tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo.
Amar rav chisda: may "achar"? achar achar.
Veha katane ala: nimtza al shellah leachar zeman — temein missafek, ufeturin min hakkorban. ezehu "achar zeman"? kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha.

Hachi kaamar: ezehu "achar zeman"? kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo, uchede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha — machloket rabbi akiva vachachamim.
Veha "achar kach" katane! hachi kaamar: vezehu "achar kach" shennechleku rabbi akiva vachachamim.

Rav ashe amar: idde veidde chad shiura hu, ed beyadah — kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha, en ed beyadah — kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo.
Metivi: ezehu "achar zeman"? davar ze shaal rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok lifne chachamim beusha, veamar lahem:

a: Shemma kerabbi akiva attem omrim shemmetammea et boalah? amru lo: lo shamanu.
Amar lahem: kach pershu chachamim beyavne: lo shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha — toch zeman hu ze, utemein missafek, ufeturin mikkorban, vechayyayvin beasham taluy.
Shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha — achar hazzeman hu ze.

Vechen kesheshshahata meet leet umippekida lifkida, boalah metamme mishshum magga, veeno metamme mishshum boel. rabbi akiva omer: af metamme mishshum boel. rabbi yehuda beno shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer: balah nichnas lahechol umaktir ketoret.
Bishlama lerav chisda, hayeynu dimtahari rabbanan.
Ella lerav ashe, ammay metahari rabbanan?
Vechi tema: deen ed beyadah, hay "ed beyadah" veen ed beyadah" mibbee leh! kashya.
Rabbi yehuda beno shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer: balah nichnas lahechol umaktir ketoret. vetippok leh dehave nogea bemeet leet shebbenidda!
Hu deamar keshammay, deamar: kol hannashim dayyayn sheatan.
Vetippok leh dehave baal keri! beshello gamar biato.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa ketem, amar rav lemafrea, verabbi meir hi.
Ushemuel amar: mikkan ulehabba, verabbanan hi. mikkan ulehabba peshita!
Mahu detema: hoil umeet leet derabbanan, uchetamim derabbanan — ma meet leet lo metammea et boalah, af ketamim — lo metammea et boalah, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! hatam — en "shor shachut lefanecha", hacha — yesh "shor shachut lefanecha".
Vechen amar resh lakish: lemafrea, verabbi meir hi. rabbi yochanan amar: mikkan ulehabba, verabbanan hi.
Mishna kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levalehen, habbain min hadderech — neshehen lahen bechezkat tohora.
Gemara lema leh lemitne "habbain min hadderech"? salka datach amena: hane mille hecha deiteh bemata, deramya annafsha uvadka, aval hecha deleteh bemata, dela ramya annafsha — la. ka mashma lan.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: vehu shebba umetzaah betoch yeme onatah.
Amar rav huna: lo shanu ella sheen lah veset, aval yesh lah veset — asur leshammesh.
Kelappe leyay? adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! en lah veset — ema chazay, yesh lah veset — veset kevia la!
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello higgia (sheat) [et] vistah, aval higgia (sheat) [et] vistah — asura. kasavar: vesatot deorayyta.
Rabba bar bar channa amar: afillu higgia sheat vistah name mutteret, kasavar: vesatot derabbanan.
Rav ashe matne hachi, amar rav huna:
b: Lo shanu ella sheen lah veset leyamim, ella yesh lah veset leyamim velikfitzot, kevan divmaase talya milleta — ema la kefitz vela chazay, aval yesh lah veset leyamim — asura leshammesh.
Kasavar vesatot deorayyta.
Rabba bar bar chana amar: afillu yesh lah veset leyamim — mutteret, kasavar vesatot derabbanan.
Amar rav shemuel mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset — balah mechashshev yeme vistah, uva aleha.
Amar leh rav shemuel bar yeva lerabbi abba: amar rabbi yochanan afillu yalda divziza lemitbal?
Amar leh: attu vadday raata mi amar rabbi yochanan?! emar deamar rabbi yochanan safek raata safek lo raata, veim timtza lomar raata — ema tavla,
Aval vadday raata — mi yemar detavla? have leh safek uvadday, veen safek motzi mide vadday.

Vela? vehatanya: chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot, afillu hen bene yoman — hare hen bechezkat metukkanin. veha hacha, vadday tevel, safek meussar safek eno meussar, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
Hatam vadday uvadday hu, kidrav chanina chozaa, deamar rav chanina chozaa: chazaka al chaver sheeno motzi mittachat yado davar sheeno metukkan.
Veibbaet ema: safek vesafek hu, vechidrabbi oshaya, deamar rabbi oshaya: maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet ufetura min hammaaser.
Veakkatti en safek motzi mide vadday? vehatanya: maase beshifchato shel massik echad berimmon, shehetila nefel levor, uva kohen vehetzitz bo leda im zachar im nekeva.
Uva maase lifne chachamim, vetiharuhu, mippene shechuleda uvardelas metzuyim sham.
Veha hacha, devadday hetila nefel, safek geraruhu safek lo geraruhu, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
La tema "hetila nefel levor", ella ema

a: Kemin nefel.
Veha "leda im zachar im nekeva" katane!
Hachi kaamar: uva kohen vehetzitz bo, leda im nefel hippila im ruach hippila, veim timtze lomar nefel hippila — leda im zachar im nekeva.
Veibbaet ema, kevan dechuleda uvardelas metzuyim sham — vadday geraruhu.
Beo minneh merav nachman: vesatot deorayyta o derabbanan?

Amar lehu middeamar huna chavrin mishshemeh derav: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka, ulevassof raata — chosheshet levistah, vechosheshet liriyyaytah. alma vesatot deorayyta.
Ikka deamri, hachi kaamar lehu: tama deraata, ha lo raata — en choshshin, alma vesatot derabbanan.

Ittemar: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka, ulevassof badka — amar rav: badka umatzat temea — temea, tehora — tehora. ushemuel amar: afillu badka umatzat tehora name temea, mippene sheorach bizmanno ba.
Lema, bivsatot kamippalgi, demar savar deorayyta, umar savar derabbanan.
Amar rabbi zera: dechulle alma vesatot deorayyta, kan — shebbadka atzmah keshiur veset, kan — shello badka atzmah keshiur veset.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: bivsatot gufayyhu kamippalgi, demar savar: vesatot deorayyta, umar savar: vesatot derabbanan.
Amar rav sheshet: ketannae, rabbi eliezer omer: temea nidda.
Verabbi yehoshua omer: tibbadek, vehane tannae ki hane tannae, detanya: rabbi meir omer: temea nidda, vachachamim omrim: tibbadek.

Amar abbaye: af anan name tenena, ditnan: rabbi meir omer: im hayta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka — tehora, shecharada mesalleket et haddamim. tama deikka charada, ha lekka charada — temea, alma vesatot deorayyta.
Lema hane tannae beha name peligi, detanya: haroa dam mechamat makka, afillu betoch yeme niddatah — tehora, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel.
Rabbi omer: im yesh lah veset — chosheshet levistah.
May lav, beha kamippalgi: demar savar vesatot deorayyta, umar savar vesatot derabbanan?
Amar ravina: la, dechulle alma vesatot derabbanan, vehacha bemakor mekomo tame kamippalgi.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: ishsha tehora vedam tame, dekaate derech makor.
Vaamar leh rabbi: i chayyshat leveset, ishsha name temea, vei la chayyshat leveset, makor mekomo tahor hu.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: tzericha shene edim al kol tashmish vetashmish, o teshammesh leor hanner. bet hillel omrim: dayyah bishne edim kol hallayla.
b: Gemara tanu rabbanan: af al pi sheamru hameshammesh mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne, bet shammay omrim: tzericha shene edim al kol tashmish, o teshammesh leor hanner. uvet hillel omrim: dayyah bishne edim kol hallayla.
Tanya: amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel: ledivrechem, lechush shemma tire tippat dam kechardal bevia rishona, utechappenna shichvat zera bevia sheniyya.
Amru lahem bet hillel: af ledivrechem, lechush ad sheharok betoch happe, shemma nimmok veholech lo.
Amru lahem: lefi sheeno dome nimmok paam achat, lenimmok shete peamim.
Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: roe ani et divre bet shammay. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kamma heerachta alenu! amar lahem: mutav sheaarich alechem baolam hazze, kede sheyyaarichu yemechem laolam habba.
Amar rabbi zera: middivre kullam nilmad, baal nefesh — lo yivol veyishne.
Rava amar: boel veshona, ki tanya hahi — litharot.

Tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim — litharot, aval levalah — mutteret. uvamme devarim amurim — shehinnichah bechezkat tohora, aval hinnichah bechezkat temea — leolam hi bechezkatah, ad shettomar lo "tehora ani".

Amar rabbi abba, amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe, amar rav: badka beed veavad — asura leshammesh ad shettivdok. matkef la rabbi ila: illu ite — mi la meshammesha, veaf al gav dela yada? hasheta name teshammesh!
Amar leh rava: zo mochichah kayyaym, vezo en mochichah kayyaym.

Amar rabbi yochanan: asur laadam sheyyeshammesh mittato bayyom. amar rav hamenuna: may kera? shenneemar: "yovad yom ivvaled bo vehallayla amar hora gaver" — layla nittan leherayon, veyom lo nittan leherayon. resh lakish amar mehacha: "boze derachav yamut".

Veresh lakish, hay kera derabbi yochanan may daresh beh? mibbae leh lechiddaresh rabbi chanina bar pappa, dedaresh rabbi chanina bar pappa: oto malach hamemunne al haherayon "layla" shemo, venotel tippa umaamidah lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, veomer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, tippa zo ma tehe aleha? gibbor o challash? chacham o tippesh? ashir o ani?

Veillu rasha o tzaddik la kaamar, kidrabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim, chutz miyyirat shamayim, shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira vegomer".
Verabbi yochanan, im ken nichtov kera "gever hora", may "hora gever"? layla nittan leherayon, veyom lo nittan leherayon.

Verabbi yochanan, hay kera deresh lakish may daresh beh? mibbee leh lichdichtiv besefer ben sira: shelosha saneti vearbaa lo ahavti — sar hannirgal bevet hammishtaot, veamri lah: "sar hannirgan", veamri la: "sar hannirgaz".
Vehammoshiv shabbat bimrome keret, vehaochez baamma umashtin mayim, vehannichnas levet chavero pitom. amar rabbi yochanan: vaafillu leveto.
Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: arbaa devarim hakkadosh baruch hu sonan, vaani eni ohavan — hannichnas leveto pitom, veen tzarich lomar levet chavero, vehaochez baamma umashtin mayim,

a: Umashtin mayim arum lifne mittato, vehameshammesh mittato bifne kol chay. amar leh rav yehuda lishmuel: vaafillu lifne achbarim? amar leh: shinnana, la! ella kegon shel bet peloni shemmeshammeshin mittotehen bifne avdehem veshifchotehem.
Veinhu may derush? "shevu lachem po im hachamor" — am haddome lachamor.
Rabba bar rav huna mekarkesh zage dechilleta, abbaye bale didve, rava bale paroche.

Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: chamishsha devarim hen shehaose otan mitchayyev benafsho vedamo berosho — haochel shum kaluf, uvatzal kaluf, uvetza kelufa, vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayla, vehallan bevet hakkevarot, vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim, vehammakkiz dam umeshammesh mittato.

Haochel shum kaluf kulei. veaf al gav demannechi besilleta umetzayyeyri vachatimi — ruach raa shora alehen. vela amaran ella dela shiyyer bahen ikkaran o kelippatan, aval shiyyer bahen ikkaran o kelippatan — let lan ba.

Vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayla. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu shellanu bichle mattachot. amar rav pappa: uchele neter kichle mattachot damu. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shellanu bichle mattachot, uchele neter kichle mattachot damu.
Vehallan bevet hakkevarot — kede shettishre alav ruach tumea, zimnin dimsakkenin leh.

Vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim — mippene sheishsha meubberet overet alehen umappelet. vela amaran ella deshakel bignusetre, vela amaran ella deshakel dideh udechareh, vela amaran ella dela gaz midde batrayyhu, aval gaz midde batrayyhu — let lan ba. vela hi, lechulla milleta chayyshinan.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim neemru batztzippornayim: sorfan — chasid, kovran — tzaddik, zorkan — rasha.

Vehammakkiz dam umeshammesh mittato — deamar mar: makkiz dam umeshammesh mittato — hoviyn lo banim vittekin. hikkizu shenehem veshimmeshu — hoviyn lo banim baale ratan. amar rav: vela amaran ella dela teem midde, aval teem midde — let lan ba.

Amar rav chisda: asur lo laadam sheyyeshammesh mittato bayyom, shenneemar: "veahavta lereacha kamocha". may mashma? amar abbaye: shemma yire bah davar megunne vetitganne alav. amar rav huna: yisrael kedoshim hem, veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom.
Amar rava: veim haya bayit afel — muttar, vetalmid chacham — maafil bichsuto umeshammesh.
Tenan: o teshammesh leor hanner! ema: tivdok leor hanner.
Ta shema: af al pi sheamru: hameshammesh mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne! ema: habbodek mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne.

Ta shema: veshel bet monbaz hammelech hayu osin shelosha devarim, umazkirin otan leshevach — hayu meshammeshin mittotehem bayyom, uvodkin mittotehem bemela parhava, venohagin tumea vetohora bishlagim. katane miha: meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom!
Ema: bodkin mittotehem bayyom. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach "meshammeshin" — mazkirin otan leshevach? in hachi name, deaggav deikka ones shena — migganneya beappeh.

Uvodkin mittotehen bemela parhava — mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: en bodkin et hammitta ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach. amar rav: hayeynu dechi havay hatam bearve shabbatot, havo amri: "man bae pakole benahama", vela yadana may kaamri.
Amar rava: hane shachake dechittana meallu livdika. ini? veha tana deve menashshe: en bodkin et hammitta lo beed edom, velo beed shachor, velo befishtan, ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach!
La kashya — ha bechittana, ha bemane dechittana. veibbaet ema: ha veha bemane dechittana — ha bechadte, ha beshachake.
Nohagin tumea vetohora bishlagin. tenan hatam: sheleg eno lo ochel velo mashke, chishshev alav laachila — eno metamme tumeat ovchalin, lemashke — metamme tumeat mashkin.
Nitma miktzato — lo nitma kullo, nithar miktzato — nithar kullo.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "nitma miktzato — lo nitma kullo", vahadar (tane) [amrat] "nithar miktzato — nithar kullo", lememra denitma kullo!
Amar abbaye: kegon sheheeviro al avir tannur, dehattora heida al keli cheres
b: Afillu male chardal.
Mishna mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha: hacheder, vehapperozdor, vehaaliyyay.
Dam hacheder — tame, dam haaliyyay — tahor, nimtza bapperozdor — sefeko tame, lefi shechezkato min hammakor.

Gemara rame bar shemuel verav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda teno nidda be rav huna. ashkechinhu rabba bar rav huna deyatvi vekaamri: hacheder mibbifnim, vehapperozdor mibbachutz, vaaliyyay benuya al shetehen, velul patuach ben aliyyay lapperozdor.
Nimtza min hallul velifnim — sefeko tame, min hillul velachutz — sefeko tahor.
Ata vaamar leh laavu: sefeko tame amart lan mar? veha anan "shechezkato min hammakor" tenan!
Amar leh: ana hachi kaamena — min hallul velifnim vadday tame, min hallul velachutz sefeko tame.
Amar abbaye: may shena min hallul velachutz, disfeko tame? dedilma shachata, umecheder ata. min hallul velifnim name, ema: izdekara, umealiyyay ata!
Ella amar abbaye: i batar chashasha azlat — idde veidde safek hu, vei batar chazaka azlat — min hallul velifnim vadday tame, min hallul velachutz vadday tahor.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: dam hannimtza bapperozdor — chayyayvin alav al biat mikdash, vesorfin alav et hatteruma. verav kattina amar: en chayyayvin alav al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alav et hatteruma.
Lehach lishshana deamar abbaye: "i batar chashasha azlat" — mesayyay leh lerav kattina, ufeliga derabbi chiyyay.
Lehach lishshana deamrat: "i batar chazaka azlat" — mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay,

a: Ufeliga derav kattina.
Lerav huna, la peligi — kan min hallul velifnim, kan min hallul velachutz.
Ella lerame bar shemuel ulerav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, deamri: min hallul velachutz — sefeko tahor, min hallul velifnim — sefeko tame, hane bemay mittokma? min hallul velifnim.
Lema peliga derabbi chiyyay!
La kashya, kan — keshennimtza bakkarka perozdor, vechan — shennimtza begag perozdor.
Amar rabbi yochanan: bishlosha mekomot halchu bo chachamim achar harov, vaasaum kevadday: makor, shilya, chaticha. makor — ha daamaran;
Shilya — ditnan: shilya bevayit, habbayit tame, velo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya belo valad. rabbi shimon omer: nimmok havvalad ad shello yatza;
Chaticha — ditnan: hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha, immo temea leda, veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bat.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka tesha chanuyot!
Detanya: tesha chanuyot, kullan mochrot besar shechuta, veachat mocheret besar nevela, velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach — sefeko asur.
Uvannimtza — hallech achar harov.
Tumea kaamrinan, issur la kaamrinan.
Vehaikka tesha tzefardein vesheretz echad benehem, venaga beechad mehen, veeno yodea beeze mehen naga — birshut hayyachid sefeko tame, birshut harabbim sefeko tahor,
Uvannimtza — hallech achar harov!
Tumea deishsha kaamrinan, tumea bealma la kaamrinan.
Vehaikka ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: avra bannahar
b: Vehippila — mevia korban veneechol.
Hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim — valad mealleya yaldan.
Matnitin kaamrinan, shematata la kaamrinan.
Veha ki ata ravin, amar: metiv rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina toa, vela yadana may teyuveteh.
May lav la teyuveta, ella siyyayta?
La, dilma la teyuveta velo siyyayta.
Lemaote may?
Illema lemaote rubba, deikka chazaka bahadeh, dela sarfinan aleh et hatteruma — veha amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna!
Ditnan: tinok hannimtza betzad haissa, uvatzek beyado — rabbi meir metaher, vachachamim metammein, sheddarko shel tinok letappeach.
Veamrinan: may tama derabbi meir? kasavar: rov tinokot metappechin, umiut en metappechin, veissa zo bechezkat tehora omedet, semoch miuta lachazaka, veittera leh rubba.
Verabbanan miuta "keman deleteh dame", verubba vachazaka — rubba adif.
Veamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya: zo hi chazaka shessorfin aleha et hatteruma, verabbi yochanan amar: en zo chazaka shessorfin aleha et hatteruma!
Ella lemaote rubba derabbi yehuda, ditnan: hammappelet chaticha — im yesh immah dam temea, veim lav — tehora. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach temea.

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo timme rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arba mine damim, aval shear mine damim — tehora. verabbi yochanan amar: shel arba mine damim — divre hakkol temea, veshel shear damim — divre hakkol tehora. lo nechleku ella keshehippila

a: Veenah yodaat ma hippila, rabbi yehuda savar: zil batar rov chatichot, verov chatichot shel arba mine damim havyayn. verabbanan savri: zil batar rov chatichot la amrinan.

Mishna chamishsha damim temeim baishsha, haadom, vehashshachor, uchekeren karkom, uchememe adama, vechammazug. bet shammay omrim: af kememe tiltan, uchememe basar tzali, uvet hillel metaharim. hayyarok — akavya ben mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin.
Amar rabbi meir: im eno metamme mishshum ketem, metamme mishshum mashke. rabbi yose omer: lo kach velo kach.
Ezehu adom — kedam hammakka; shachor — kecheret; amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — tahor; uchekeren karkom — kabbarur shebbo;
Uchememe adama — mibbikat bet kerem, umetzef mayim; vechammazug — shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni.
Gemara menalan deikka dam tahor baishsha? dilma kol dam deate minna tame!
Amar rabbi chama bar yosef, amar rabbi oshaya, amar kera: "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat ben dam ledam", ben dam tahor ledam tame.
Ella meatta, ben nega lanega, hachi name ben nega tame lenega tahor? vechi tema hachi name — nega tahor mi ikka? vechi tema "kullo hafach lavan tahor hu" — hahu "bohak" mikkere!
Ella: ben nige adam lenige vattim ulenige vegadim, vechullan temein. hacha name: ben dam nidda ledam ziva, vechullan temein!
Hay may? bishlama hatam, ikka leippeloge [zaken mamre verabbanan] benige adam, uviflugeta derabbi yehoshua verabbanan.
Ditnan: im baheret kodem lesear lavan — tame, veim sear lavan kodem labbaheret — tahor, safek — tame, verabbi yehoshua omer: keha. veamar rabba: keha vetahor.

Benige vattim — ki ha pelugeta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan, ditnan: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishne gerisin al shene avanim bishne kevtalim bekeren zavit, orko kishne gerisin verochbo kigris.
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon? ketiv "kir" uchetiv "kirot" — ezehu kir shehu kishne kirot? heve omer: ze keren zavit.
Benige vegadim — biflugeta derabbi yonatan ben avtulemos verabbanan, detanya: rabbi yonatan ben avtulemos omer: minnayin lifrichat begadim shehi tehora?
Neemar "karachat" vegabbachat" babbegadim, veneemar "kerachat" vegabbachat" baadam.
Ma lehallan parach bechullo tahor, af kan name parach bechullo tahor.
Ella hacha, i dam tahor lekka, bemay peligi?
Umimmay dehane tehorin, vehane temein? amar rabbi avahu: deamar kera: "vayyiru moav et hammayim adummim kaddam", lememra dedam adom hu? ema adom, vetu la!
Amar rabbi avahu: amar kera "dameha" "dameha", hare kan arbaa.
Veha anan "chamishsha" tenan! amar rabbi chanina: shachor — adom hu, ella shellaka.
