Tanya name hachi: shachor — kecheret; amok mikken — tame, dehe afillu kichchol — tahor. veshachor ze lo mittechillato hu mashchir, ella keshenneekar hu mashchir. mashal ledam makka: lichshenneekar hu mashchir.
Bet shammay omrim: af kememe tiltan. velet lehu levet shammay "dameha" "dameha" — hare kan arbaa?
Ibbaet ema: let lehu, veibbaet ema: it lehu. mi la amar rabbi chanina: shachor — adom hu, ella shellaka? hachi name, milka hu delake.
Uvet hillel metaharin. hayeynu tanna kamma!
Ikka venayyhu
b: Litlot.
Hayyarok, akavya ben mahalalel metamme. velet leh laakavya "dameha" "dameha" — hare kan arbaa?
Ibbaet ema: let leh, veibbaet ema: it leh, mi la amar rabbi chanina: shachor — adom hu, ella shellaka? hacha name, milka hu delake.
Vachachamim metaharin. hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka venayyhu litlot.
Amar rabbi meir: "im eno metamme mishshum ketem" kulei.

Amar rabbi yochanan: yarad rabbi meir leshitat akavya ben mahalalel, vetimme. vehachi kaamar lehu lerabbanan: nehi dehecha deka mashkachat ketem yarok ammana la metammeitu, hecha dekachazya dam yarok miggufa — tetamme.
I hachi, im eno metamme mishshum ketem, metamme mishshum mashke? mishshum roa mibbaya leh!
Ella hachi kaamar lehu: nehi hecha deka chazya dam yarok meikkara — la metammeitu, hecha dechazya dam adom vahadar chazya dam yarok — tetamme, mide dehave ammashke zav vezava.
Verabbanan, dumeya derok: ma rok shemmitaggel veyotze, af kol shemmitaggel veyotze, leappoke hay deen mitaggel veyotze. i hachi, shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir.
Ella, hachi kaamar lehu: leheve kemashke lehacheshir et hazzeraim. verabbanan bae "dam chalalim", velekka. i hachi, shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir!
Ella hachi kaamar lehu: allefuha bigzera shava, ketiv hacha "shelachayich pardes rimmonim", uchetiv hatam: "vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot".
Verabbanan? adam dan kal vachomer meatzmo, veen adam dan gezera shava meatzmo.
Rabbi yose omer: lo kach vechulei. hayeynu tanna kamma! ha ka mashma lan: man tanna kamma? rabbi yose, vechol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam.
Ezehu adom — kedam hammakka. may "kedam hammakka"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kedam shor shachut.
Velema "kedam shechita"! i amar "kedam shechita" — hava amena kechulla shechita, ka mashma lan "kedam hammakka" — kitchillat hakkaa shel sakkin.
Ulla amar: kedam tzippor chayya. ibbaya lehu: chayya — leappoke shachut, o dilma leappoke kachush? teku.
Zeeri amar rabbi chanina: kedam maacholet shel rosh. metivi: harga maacholet — hare zo tola bah. may lav dechulleh gufa? la, deresha.
Amme vardinaa, amar rabbi avahu: kedam etzba ketanna shel yad, shenniggefa vechayyta vechazra veniggefa. velo shel kol adam, ella shel bachur shello nasa ishsha. vead kamma? ad ben esrim.
Metivi: tole bivnah uvevalah? bishlama bivnah — mashkachat la, ella balah — hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon shennichnesa lachuppa, velo nivala.
Rav nachman amar: kedam hakkaza. metivi: maase vetala rabbi meir

a: Bekilor, verabbi tala bisraf shikma. may lav aadom?
La, ashshear damim.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havo yatvi kammeh ummana, shakli leh karna kammayyta leammemar, chazyeh, amar lehu: "adom" ditnan ki hay, shakli leh achariti, amar lehu: ishtanni, amar rav ashe: kegon ana dela yadana ben hay lehay — la mibbee li lemichze dema.

Shachor — kecheret. amar rabba bar rav huna: cheret sheamru — deyo. tanya name hachi: shachor kecheret, veshachor sheamru — deyo. velema deyo! i amar deyo — hava amena ki fichchuta didyota, ka mashma lan ki charuta didyota.
Ibbaya lehu: belacha o beyabbishta? ta shema: derabbi amme pale kureta didyota uvadek be.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kekir, kidyo ucheenav — temea, vezohi sheshshaninu: "amok mikken — temea". amar rabbi elazar: kezayit, kezefet ucheorev — tahor, vezohi sheshshaninu: "dehe mikken — tahor".
Ulla amar: kilvusha siyyua. ulla ikkela lefumebdita, chazyeh lehahu tayyaya dilvivsh levusha ukkama. amar lehu: "shachor" ditnan ki hay. meratu minneh pureta pureta, yehavu beh arba mea zuze.

Rabbi yochanan amar: ellu kelim haolyayrin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam. lememra deukkame ninhu? vehaamar lehu rabbi yannay levanav: banay, al tikberuni lo bechelim shechorim velo bechelim levanim. shechorim — shema ezke veehye keavel ben hachatanim, levanim — shemma lo ezke veehye kechatan ben haavelim, ella bechelim haolyayrin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam.
Alma lav ukkame ninhu! la kashya — ha biglima, ha befatura.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vechullam, en bodkin ella al gabbe matlet levana. amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: veshachor al gabbe adom.
Amar rav yirmeya middifti: vela peligi — ha beshachor, ha bishar damim. matkef la rav ashe: i hachi, lema shemuel "chutz mishshachor"! ella amar rav ashe: beshachor gufeh kamippalgi.
Amar ulla: kullan, amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — tahor, kashshachor.
Veella may shena shachor denaket? salka datach amina: hoil veamar rabbi chanina "shachor adom hu ella shellaka", hilkach afillu dehe mikken name litamme? kamashma lan.
Rabbi amme bar abba amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — name tame, chutz mishshachor. ella may ahani shiure derabbanan? leappoke dehe dedeha.
Veikka deamri, rame bar abba amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tahor, dehe mikken — tahor, chutz mishshachor, ulehachi mahane shiure derabbanan.

Bar kappara amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — tahor. chutz mimmezeg, sheamok mikken — tahor, dehe mikken — tahor. bar kappara adihu leh — vedakki, aamiku leh — vedakki. amar rabbi chanina: kamma nefish gavra delibbeh (kameshameateyh) [kishmateh]!
Uchekeren karkom. tana: lach, velo yavesh.
Tane chada: kattachton, lo kaelyon. vetanya iddach: kaelyon, velo kattachton. vetanya iddach: kaelyon, vechol shekken kattachton. vetanya iddach: kattachton, vechol shekken kaelyon.
Amar abbaye: telata dare utelata tarfe havyayn.
Nekot dara metziaa, vetarpa (matzeyataa) [metzia] bidach.
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi avahu, amar lehu: begushayyhu shaninu.

Uchememe adama. tanu rabbanan: kememe adama — mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif aleha mayim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi akiva omer: mibbikat yodfat. rabbi yose omer: mibbikat sichni. rabbi shimon omer: af mibbikat ginnosar vechayyotze bahen.

Tanya iddach: uchememe adama — mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif aleha mayim kiklippat hashshum, veen shiur lammayim, mishshum deen shiur leafar, veen bodkin otan tzelulin, ella achurin. tzallu — chozer veochran, ucheshehu ochran — en ochran bayyad ella bichli.
Ibbaya lehu: en ochrin otan bayyad ella bichli — dela lirmeye bideh velakerinhu, aval bemana ki achar leh bideh — shappir dame, o dilma dela lakerinhu bideh ella bemana?
Ta shema: keshehu bodkan, en bodkan ella bechos. vaadayin tibbee lach: bedika bechos, achira bemay? teku.
Ki atu lekammeh derabba bar avu, amar lehu: bimkomah shaninu. rabbi chanina pale kureta degargishta uvadek beh, layet aleh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose beaskara.
b: Rabbi chanina hu dechakkim, kulle alma lav chakkimi hachi.

Amar rabbi yochanan: chuchmeta derabbi chanina gerama li dela echze dema, metammena — metahar, metaharna — metamme. amar rabbi elazar: invevtanuta derabbi chanina gerama li dachazay dema, uma rabbi chanina deinvetan hu — machet nafsheh lesafek vechaze, ana la echze?
Amar rabbi zera: tiva devavel gerama li dela chazay dema, deamena: betiva la yadana, bidma yadana?!
Lememra divtiva talya milleta? veha rabba hu deyada betiva, vela yada bidma! kol shekken kaamar: uma rabba deyada betiva — la chaza dema, vaana echze?!
Ulla ikkela lefumebdita, ayyto lekammeh dema vela chaza. amar: uma rabbi elazar demara deara deyisrael hava, ki mikkela leatra derabbi yehuda — la chaze dema, ana echze?!

Veammay karu leh "mara deara deyisrael"? dehahi itteta (daayytaa) [deayytay] dema lekammeh derabbi elazar, hava yatev rabbi amme kammeh. archeh, amar la: hay dam chimmud hu. batar denafka, ittefal la rabbi amme. amara leh: baali haya badderech vachamadtiv. kare aleh: "sod Adonai lireav".

Ifra hormiz, immeh deshabbur malka, shaddara dema lekammeh derava. hava yatev rav ovadya kammeh, archeh. amar la: hay dam chimmud hu. amara leh livreh: ta chazi kamma chakkime yehudae! amar la: dilma kesome baarubba.
Hadar shaddara leh shittin mine dema, vechullehu amrinhu. hahu batra dam kinnim hava, vela yeda. istayyay milleta, veshaddar la serikuta dimkattela kalme. amara: yehudae, bitvavne delibba yatvitu!
Amar rav yehuda: meresha hava chazena dema, kevan deamra li immeh deyitzchak beri, hay tippeta kammayyta la mayytinan la kammayyhu derabbanan mishshum dizhima — la chazena.
Ben temea lithora — vadday chazena.
Yalta (ayytea) [ayytay] dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa, vetammi la. hadar (ayytea) [ayytay] lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, vedakki la.
Vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya: chacham shettimme — en chavero rashshay letaher, asar — en chavero rashshay lehattir!
Meikkara tammoye hava metamme la, kevan daamara leh dechol yoma hava medakke li ki hay gavna, vehaiddana hu dechash beeneh — dakki la.
Umi mehemna? in, vehatanya: neemenet ishsha lomar "kaze raiti veibbadtiv".
Ibbaya lehu: "kaze tiher ish peloni chacham", mahu?
Ta shema: neemenet ishsha lomar "kaze raiti veibbadtiv", shane hatam, deleteh lekamme.

Ta shema: deyalta (ayytea) [ayytay] dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa — vetammi la. lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda — vedakki la. vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya: "chacham shettimme en chavero rashshay letaher" vechulei,
Veamrinan: tammoye hava metamme la, kevan daamara leh dechol yoma medakke la ki hay gavna, vehaiddana hu dechash beeneh — hadar dakki la, alma mehemna le!
Rav yitzchak bar yehuda aggemareh semach.
Rabbi raa dam ballayla vetimme, raa bayyom vetiher, himtin shaa achat chazar vetimme, amar: oy li shemma taiti!
Shemma taiti? vadday taa! detanya: lo yomar chacham "illu haya lach — haya vadday tame".

Ella (amar): en lo laddayyayn ella ma sheenav root. meikkara achzekeh betame, kevan dachaza letzafra deishtanni amar (leh): vadday tahor hava, uvallayla hu dela itchazi shappir. kevan dachaza dahadar ishtanni amar: hay tame hu, umifkach hu deka (mapekach) [fachach] veazel.

Rabbi badek leor hanner. rabbi yishmael berabbi yosef badek beyom hameunnan bene ammude. amar rav amme bar shemuel: vechullan en bodkin otan ella ben chamma letzel. rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: bechamma uvetzel yado.
Vechammazug shene chalakim kulei. tana:

a: Hashsharoni niddon kakkarmeli, chay velo mazug, chadash velo yashan.

Amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: vechullan, en bodkin otan ella bechos teverya pashut. may tama? amar abbaye: shel kol haolam kullo machzik log — osin oto mimmane, shene luggin — osin oto mimmatayim. kos teverya pashut, afillu machazik shene luggin — osin oto mimmane, veayyeyde diklish — yedia beh tefe.
Hadaran alach kol hayyad.
Mishna hammappelet chaticha, im yesh immah dam — temea, veim lav — tehora. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach — temea.
Hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin saara, kemin afar, kemin yavchushin adummim — tatil lammayim: im nimmochu — temea, veim lav — tehora.
Hammappelet kemin dagim, chagavim, shekatzim uremasim — im yesh immahem dam temea, veim lav — tehora.
Hammappelet min behema, chayya vaof, ben temein ben tehorin — im zachar — teshev lezachar, veim nekeva — teshev linkeva.
Veim en yadua — teshev lezachar velannekeva, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim: kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam eno valad.
Gemara amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: lo timme rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaat mine damim, aval shel shear mine damim — tehora.
Verabbi yochanan amar: shel arbaat mine damim — divre hakkol temea, shel shear mine damim — divre hakkol tehora.

Lo nechleku ella shehippila, veenah yodaat ma hippila. rabbi yehuda savar: zil batar rov chatichot, verov chatichot shel (mine) arbaat mine damim havyayn. verabbanan savri: la amrinan rov chatichot shel arbaat mine damim.

Ini? veha ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea, ata veayyti matnita bideh: hammappelet chaticha adumma, shechora, yerukka, ulevana — im yesh immah dam temea, veim lav — tehora. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach temea. kashya lishmuel bachada, ulerabbi yochanan betarte.
Lishmuel bachada, deamar shemuel: lo timme rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaat mine damim, veha katane "yerukka ulevana", ufelig rabbi yehuda!
Vechi tema, ki pelig rabbi yehuda aadumma ushechora, veayyerukka ulevana la, ella yerukka ulevana leman katane la?
Illema rabbanan — hasheta adumma ushechora metahari rabbanan, yerukka ulevana mibbaya? ella lav lerabbi yehuda, ufelig!
Vetu, lerabbi yochanan deamar: shel arbaat mine damim — divre hakkol temea, ha katane: adumma ushechora, ufeligi rabbanan!
Vechi tema, ki peligi rabbanan ayyerukka ulevana, aval aadumma ushechora la, ella adumma ushechora leman katane la?
Ilema rabbi yehuda — hasheta yerukka ulevana temea, adumma ushechora mibbaya? ella lav rabbanan, ufeligi!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: beefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamippalgi, uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: kishsheta shenayim, velashshelishi hippila, veenah yodaat ma hippila,
b: Hare zo sefek leda sefek ziva, mevia korban veeno neechol.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: mevia korban veneechol, shei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam.
Lishshana achrina amri la: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo timme rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaa mine damim, aval shel shear mine damim — tehora.

Ini? veha ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea, ata veayyti matnita bideh: hammappelet chaticha adumma, ushechora, yerukka, ulevana — im yesh immah dam — temea, veim lav — tehora. verabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach temea.
Katane "adumma ushechora, yerukka ulevana", ufelig rabbi yehuda!
Vechi tema, ki pelig rabbi yehuda aadumma ushechora, aval yerukka ulevana la, ella yerukka ulevana man katane la?
Illema lerabbanan — hasheta adumma ushechora ka metahari rabbanan, yerukka ulevana mibbaya? ella lav lerabbi yehuda, ufelig!

Ella amar rav yehuda: beefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamippalgi, uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: kishsheta shenayim, velashshelishi hippila, veenah yodaat ma hippila — hare zo sefek leda sefek ziva, mevia korban veeno neechol.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: mevia korban veneechol, lefi shei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam.
Tanu rabbanan: hammappelet chaticha, somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav: korah, im yesh dam betochah — temea, veim lav — tehora.
Kerabbanan, vaadifa midderabbanan. kerabbanan — deamri: efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam. vaadifa midderabbanan — deinhu savri: immah — in, betochah — la, vesomchos savar: afillu betochah.
Vetanya iddach: hammappelet chaticha, rabbi acha omer: korah, im tochah maadim — temea, veim lav — tehora.
Kesomchos, vaadifa missomchos.

Vetanya iddach: hammappelet chaticha, rabbi binyamin omer: korah, im yesh bah etzem — immo temea leda. amar rav chisda: uvachaticha levana. vechen ki ata zuga demin chadyayv, ata veayyti matnita bideh: hammappelet chaticha levana — korah, im yesh bah etzem — immo temea leda.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: hammappelet chaticha — korah, im yesh bah dam agur — temea, veim lav — tehora, kesomchos, vekilla mikkullehu.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: haroa dam bishfoferet mahu? "bivsarah" amar rachamana, velo bishfoferet, o dilma hay "bivsarah" mibbee leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz?
Amar leh: "bivsarah" amar rachamana velo bishfoferet, dei "bivsarah" mibbae leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz, im ken nema kera "babbasar", may "bivsarah"? shema minna tarte.
Veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: hammappelet chaticha — korah, im yesh bah dam agur — temea, veim lav — tehora!
Hachi hasheta? hatam darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha, hacha en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bishfoferet.
Lema shefoferet tannae hi, detanya: hammappelet chaticha, af al pi shemmelea dam, im yesh immah dam — temea, veim lav — tehora. rabbi eliezer omer: "bivsarah" — velo bashshafir velo bachaticha.
Rabbi eliezer — hayeynu tanna kamma! ema: sherabbi eliezer omer "bivsarah" — velo bashshafir velo bachaticha.
Vachachamim omrim: en ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha. tanna kamma name tahore metaher, ella defallay palloye ikka venayyhu.
Tanna kamma savar "bivsarah" — velo bashshafir velo bachaticha, vehu haddin lishfoferet. vehane mille hecha deshia, aval pallay palloye — temea. may tameh? "bivsarah" karena beh.
Veatu rabbanan lememar: af al gav defallay palloye — en ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha. ha dam nidda vadday tame, vaafillu bishfoferet name!
Amar abbaye: bishfoferet kulle alma la peligi dithora,

a: Ki peligi bachaticha. mar savar: darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha, umar savar: en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha.
Rava amar: dechulle alma en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha.
Vehacha, beishsha tehora umekor mekomo tame kamippalgi, derabbi eliezer savar: ishsha tehora vedam tame, deha ate derech makor, verabbanan savri: ishsha tehora, umakor mekomo tahor.
Bea minneh rabba merav huna: haroe keri bekesam mahu? mimmennu amar rachamana — ad denafek mibbesaro, velo bekesam, o dilma hay "mimmennu" — ad shettetze tumeato lachutz, vaafillu bekesam name?
Amar leh: tippok leh dehu atzmo eno metamme ella bachatimat pi haamma.
Lememra denogea have? ella meatta, al yistor beziva!
Allema tanya: "zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara" — ma ziva soteret, af shichvat zera name soter?
Amar leh: setira — hayeynu tama desoter, lefi shei efshar lah belo tzichtzuche ziva.
Ella meatta, tistor kol shiva? allema tanya: "zot torat hazzav vegomer", ma ziva soteret, af shichvat zera soteret.
I ma ziva soteret kol shiva, af shichvat zera name soteret kol shiva? talmud lomar "letoma vah" — en lecha bah ella ma sheamur bah, soteret yom echad.
Amar leh: gezerat hakkatuv hi, ziva gemura dela ariva ba shichvat zera — satra kol shiva, tzichtzuche ziva daariva ba shichvat zera — la satra ella yom echad.

Bea minneh rabbi yose berabbi chanina merabbi elazar: dam yavesh mahu? "ki yazuv zov damah" amar rachamana — ad demedav dayev leh, lach — in, yavesh — la, o dilma: hay "ki yazuv zav dama" orcha demilleta hi, uleolam afillu yavesh name?
Amar leh: tenetuha, dam hannidda uvesar hammet metammein lachim viveshim. amar leh: lach venaasa yavesh — la ka mibbaya li, ki mibbaya li — yavesh meikkara.
Ha name tenetuha: hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin searah, kemin afar, kemin yavchushin adummin — tatil lammayim,
b: Im nimmochu temea. i hachi, belo nimmochu name? amar rabba: ki lo nimmochu — beriyya bifne atzmah hi.
Umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, vehatanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: shene maasim heela abba mittivin leyavne.

Maase beishsha shehayta mappelet kemin kelippot adummot, uvau veshaalu et abba, veabba shaal lachachamim, vachachamim shaalu larofim, veamru lahem: ishsha zo makka yesh lah betoch meeha, shemmimmenna mappelet kemin kelippot. tatil lammayim, im nimmochu — temea.

Veshuv maase beishsha shehayta mappelet kemin searot adummot, uvaa veshaala et abba, veabba shaal lachachamim, vachachamim larofim, veamru lahem: shuma yesh lah betoch meeha, shemmimmenna mappelet kemin searot adummot. tatil lammayim, im nimmochu — temea.

Amar resh lakish: uvefoshrin. tanya name hachi: tatil lemayim, uvefoshrin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: memaachto berok al gabbe hatztzipporen. may benayyhu? amar ravina: mauch al yede haddechak ikka venayyhu.
Hatam tenan: kamma hi sheriyyaytan befoshrin? meet leet. hacha may? mi baena meet leet, o la?
Sheretz unevela, daakoshe — baenan meet leet, aval dam derakkich — la. o dilma la shena? teku.
Hammappelet kemin dagim. veliflog name rabbi yehuda beha!

Amar resh lakish: bemachloket shenuya, verabbanan hi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella gabbe chaticha, deaved dam dekaresh vehave chaticha, aval beriyya — la have.
Ulehach lishshana deamar rabbi yochanan, bei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamippalgi, liflog name rabbi yehuda beha!
Man dematne hach lishshana, matne hachi: rabbi yochanan veresh lakish, deamri tarvayyhu, bemachloket shenuya, verabbanan hi.
Hammappelet kemin behema [vechulei].
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: may tama derabbi meir? hoil veneemra bo yetzira keadam.
Ella meatta, hammappelet demut tannin, tehe immo temea leda, hoil (veneemar) [veneemra] bo yetzira keadam, shenneemar: "vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim"!
Amri: danin yetzira mitzira, veen danin beria mitzira.
May nafka minna? ha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" — zo hi shiva zo hi bia!
Veod, nigmar beria mibberia, dichtiv "vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo"!
Amri: "vayyivra" legufeh, "vayyitzer" leafnoye, vedanin yetzira mitzira.
Adderabba: "vayyitzer" legufeh, "vayyivra" leafnoye, vedanin beria mibberia!
Ella: "vayyitzer" mufene mishshene tzedadin, mufene gabbe adam umufene gabbe behema, "vayyivra" gabbe adam mufene, gabbe tanninim eno mufene.

May mufene gabbe behema? illema middichtiv "vayyaas elohim et chayyat haaretz", uchetiv "vayyitzer [Adonai] elohim min haadama kol chayyat hassade", gabbe tannin name ippenoye mufene, dichtiv "veet kol remes haadama", uchetiv "vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim"!
"Remes" dichtiv hatam, deyabbasha hu. umay nafka minna ben mufene mitztzad echad lemufene mishshene tzedadin?

Nafka minna deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael: kol gezera shava sheenah mufena kol ikkar — en lemedin hemenna. mufena mitztzad echad, lerabbi yishmael — lemedin veen meshivin, lerabbanan — lemedin umeshivin. mufena mishshene tzedadin, divre hakkol — lemedin veen meshivin.
Verabbi yishmael, may ikka ben mufena mitztzad echad lemufena mishshene tzedadin? nafka minna, dehecha deikka mufena mitztzad echad umufena mishshene tzedadin — shavkinan mufena mitztzad echad
